| | I'm pleased to share with you that legislation decriminalizing cannabis has again passed in the House and is now headed to the Senate. Ending federal cannabis prohibition is long overdue. The **War on Drugs has been a massive failure,** and it has had a devastating effect across America – disproportionally hurting communities of color. Entire communities were upended by racist, wrongheaded enforcement of bad laws. Every state in the union has felt the impact of these flawed policies, and now voters in states across the country are demanding change. From ballooning prison population to the militarization of law enforcement; when we talk about cannabis reform, we're talking about _justice_. **I believe that equity and justice have to be at the heart of every conversation we have on this issue, not just because we must do better but also because we need to right the wrongs of the failed War on Drugs.** That's why I'm leading the fight in the Senate to remove cannabis from the federal list of controlled substances, decriminalizing its use. I'm also fighting to expunge past convictions related to cannabis use, saving taxpayer dollars. **Know this – I will do everything in my power to get legislation passed into law that ends federal cannabis prohibition.** Our nation must begin to recover, rebuild, and move on from the cruel, racist policies that drove the tragic War on Drugs. clean_body: | | | I'm pleased to share with you that legislation decriminalizing cannabis has again passed in the House and is now headed to the Senate. Ending federal cannabis prohibition is long overdue. The War on Drugs has been a massive failure, and it has had a devastating effect across America – disproportionally hurting communities of color. Entire communities were upended by racist, wrongheaded enforcement of bad laws. Every state in the union has felt the impact of these flawed policies, and now voters in states across the country are demanding change. From ballooning prison population to the militarization of law enforcement; when we talk about cannabis reform, we're talking about justice. I believe that equity and justice have to be at the heart of every conversation we have on this issue, not just because we must do better but also because we need to right the wrongs of the failed War on Drugs. That's why I'm leading the fight in the Senate to remove cannabis from the federal list of controlled substances, decriminalizing its use. I'm also fighting to expunge past convictions related to cannabis use, saving taxpayer dollars. Know this – I will do everything in my power to get legislation passed into law that ends federal cannabis prohibition. Our nation must begin to recover, rebuild, and move on from the cruel, racist policies that drove the tragic War on Drugs. You can count on me to keep up the fight. body:
Lawsuit and the Secretary of State
---
| | | | | | Volume 38 | April 20, 2022
---
|
---
| A Word from Erik
---
| | |
---|---
|
Last month, I filed a lawsuit against the Secretary of State's office for throwing out valid signatures on my nominating petition. I believe the office is either dabbling in corruption or bureaucratic incompetence, either of which are unacceptable.

Because of this, I wholeheartedly stand with Carl Andersen and Brad Dempsey in their efforts to bring suit against Colorado's Secretary of State for denying both of their petitions as well. These actions have again called into question the partisanship and integrity of the office. When I initiated a lawsuit against the Secretary of State, it was on behalf of all candidates who might be mistreated, which it now seems Dempsey and Andersen were. I was fortunate to have the option to go through the assembly process successfully, due to the timing of the Secretary of State's denial of my petitions, which resulted in me being topline on the republican primary ballot.

Only after I brought a lawsuit against the Secretary of State did her office agree to deem satisfactory dozens of signatures, but only if my campaign agreed "to stipulate to no wrong-doing by the Secretary in their initial rejection." Not only did the Secretary of State throw out provably valid signatures of registered Republican Colorado voters living in Congressional District 7, but the Secretary of State also attempted to silence me in return for those signatures being approved.

Colorado's Secretary of State's apparent corruption and incompetence is extremely disconcerting, I will do all I can to help shine a light on any misuse of government power here in Colorado or elsewhere. Coloradoans deserve better.

body:

### W[hat They Need Now](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tyjjhltl-kujkulhluu-j/)
The war in Ukraine has reached a critical stage. Russian aggression there could be truly defeated. But only if we and our NATO allies provide what's needed. You can read about it in this week's blog. [Read this entry >>](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tyjjhltl-kujkulhluu-t/)
# Previous Blog Posts
[](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tyjjhltl-kujkulhluu-i/)
### [Putin Must LOSE This War](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tyjjhltl-kujkulhluu-d/)
The Russians have failed to take Kyiv. Rather than take ALL of Ukraine, Putin may be satisfied with taking SOME of it. Biden's spokesman said our goal should be strengthening Ukraine's position at the negotiating table. Is that enough? Read my thoughts in this week's blog. [Read this entry >>](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tyjjhltl-kujkulhluu-h/) [](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tyjjhltl-kujkulhluu-k/)

The chaos at our southern border is about to get even worse, if that's possible. You can read about it in this week's blog. [Read this entry >>](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tyjjhltl-kujkulhluu-o/) [](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tyjjhltl-kujkulhluu-b/)
### [We Must Never Forget](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tyjjhltl-kujkulhluu-n/)
The focus on the international scene right now is, and ought to be, on Ukraine. But we must not forget the plight of the people of Afghanistan (abandoned by Joe Biden.) Let's not being politically correct - my opponent is Socialist Katie Porter and she is the second coming of Nancy Pelosi. She is the top Progressive leader in Washington DC. Even AOC answers to radical Katie Porter.
I'm leading the grassroots-fueled campaign to keep this seat in Republican hands--and I need your help to fund it.

| Porter has done nothing during her time in Congress besides divide our country during a pandemic.
I will bring us together. I will stop Porter from squatting in this solidly conservative seat. We will win this seat and once I am in Congress, I will defend America First Vision! I will fight for our FAITH, FAMILIES and FREEDOMS when I am in Congress.
We do not need another McCarthy-backscratcher in Congress! I am damn proud to take on the establishment.
I am currently the youngest Republican elected official in California as I serve on the Orange County Central Committee. In this position, I have taken on the Swampy establishment as I have fought tirelessly to rebuild the Orange County Republican Party into a group that fights like President Trump does.
I'm also a successful small business owner that knows how hard it is to run a business of any size in this economy--especially in a blue state like California.
Beating Katie Porter won't be easy, but I'm no stranger to winning tough fights.
My passion for public service came from the loss of my mother to cancer just ten years ago. Through that experience, I pulled myself out from underneath the poverty line to now owning an information technology and social media marketing business.
I believe in the American Dream of hard work and opportunity- because I've seen it.
I can testify to the greatness of our country, because I've felt it! Pelosi and Porter's days in Congress are numbered. Can you imagine a world where Pelosi is no longer Speaker? I can- with your help!
This race is a must-win seat in order to regain control of the House and to stop the spread of Socialism! [That's why I need your help so urgently! ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ODtDPMTNE8EC7tS_BqNCB0Fg3eOmPvdH7H7XxPN0-pSvZRhAozKBn2jMGd02tUEDJEFxQLkGnMMprUuNVqg5JNvmHUNEQeavOoyE0mRiwIW4T-XHCcD9elJPmd8DCoa1ZcnXunESqMivhjDASEQiuoY7hQhzsoTh1sykZpfdYdpcLalj3K5gPlx3G9JPyZRDgvE8vX1-qLnSu9DeUAYQVA==&c=yLWhMll1nNWlrI1VGxBIBPs8AfyIUBXg0loSO6UQP7YiqEC8DS1HzA==&ch=4E_HSgvZzu1PCZR72N_LdWl_K7r-L4rhRzF0PF44--vNZ3fTzcAhvQ==)

body:
Peter,

I've promised that my first vote in the next Congress will be to fire Nancy Pelosi.

**And I want my next vote to elect Donald J. Trump as Speaker of the House.**

But I need to know if I have your support.

I'm asking all of my top supporters who they want to see as Speaker of the House: Donald Trump or Nancy Pelosi?

I want to know if the America First movement stands with me in supporting Donald Trump for Speaker of the House.

**So I'm asking you to respond to this poll my team prepared.**

**[Please answer the poll my team specially prepared just for you and tell me if you want Donald J. Trump or Nancy Pelosi to serve as Speaker of the House](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60004552:WD2ZVUHNo:m:1:2365227053:121063356B2F788A954B7BCE844E2D05:r)**. With an army of America First conservatives by my side, I will work with a new Speaker of the House to:
---
*** **Investigate Hunter Biden's laptop** from hell and expose the Biden Crime Family's corruption. *** **Force Hillary Clinton to testify** for her treason in spying on Donald Trump's 2016 presidential campaign. *** **Build the wall** and end Joe Biden's illegal alien invasion. *** **Ban critical race theory** in the United States military.
_If Nancy Pelosi is Speaker, I can promise you Democrats will_ : continue the January 6 witch hunt to ban Donald Trump from running for President in 2024, grant amnesty to tells of millions of illegal aliens, push critical race theory in the military and schools, and push America one step closer to becoming a socialist nation.

I have a plan to stop this nightmare.

**[That's why I've prepared this one-question poll to see if you want Donald Trump or Nancy Pelosi to serve as the next Speaker of the House](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60004552:WD2ZVUHNo:m:1:2365227053:121063356B2F788A954B7BCE844E2D05:r).** [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60004552:WD2ZVUHNo:m:1:2365227053:121063356B2F788A954B7BCE844E2D05:r) [_**HELP MATT GAETZ

**The America First movement needs a strong speaker committed to an agenda to make America Great Again.**

You and I can't afford any Liz Cheney or Adam Kinzinger-type RINOs that just want to show their face on CNN and attack conservatives to win cheers from the fake news media.

I plan to vote for Donald Trump as the next Speaker of the House.

But I want to know who you want to see as the next Speaker of the House: Donald Trump or Nancy Pelosi?

**[So please answer the poll my campaign prepared so I can personally see the results](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60004552:WD2ZVUHNo:m:1:2365227053:121063356B2F788A954B7BCE844E2D05:r).**

subject: Here’s how to reach young Americans

College campuses have gone absolutely insane. Here's one thing you can do about it that can really make a difference.
|
---
| | | [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z4a9g24kg7fi9l51vuvukl9qvbv3h1j2r4qi3vtg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0clj6aoj0shh2bs) Hi Fellow Conservative, Do you want to drive liberals crazy (crazier than they already are) and give young people a chance to hear some really “inconvenient” truths? Well, I’m your liberal antidote. [ **Send me** ](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zlntvaj0pqaigb568l9t46onudtng0eh0smc6tjg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0clj6aoj0shh2bs) Today’s college students can easily go through four years of a (very expensive!) education without once hearing a conservative idea. Too many of these students are beaten down by the leftists who run their campuses. They’re brainwashed, bullied, and harassed. And when they utter the mildest dissent, _they’re shut down hard_. **So having ANN COULTER UNPLUGGED come to their campus gives conservative students a jolt of confidence!_“If Ann can do it, so can I....”_** Having a big-name speaker like me visit is one of the best ways for campus conservative groups to raise funds, gain attention, and most important, recruit new members — more often than I can count, these are former college liberals. I’m honored to do what I can to _swell the ranks of brave, committed conservative young people_. And I hope you will be too. **[Thanks to my friends at the Leadership Institute, you can help today to send me into the frontlines of the battle for free speech.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zj1kabp59qrofmhm3pfgoshr6qpt8lvvemr5k6o8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0clj6aoj0shh2bs)** The Leadership Institute kindly offered to launch me on a _high-profile campus tour_. They know better than anyone the value of rallying and recruiting young campus conservatives, and I’m delighted to work with them. Led by my good friend Morton Blackwell, the Leadership Institute has trained a whole generation of conservative leaders: **including me!** There’s no one else who does such a great job of reaching, recruiting, and training young conservatives as the Leadership Institute. They go into the belly of the beast -- college campuses -- and organize young conservatives to battle the left effectively. That’s why I’m so happy to work with Morton and his team on this new campus tour. I know I can trust them to have my back, and to make the most of this tremendous opportunity to spread our conservative ideas. With so much on the line for our future, I’ve set out to some of the most high-profile schools in the country, including:
* Arizona State University
* The University of Georgia
* Indiana University Bloomington
* and Texas Tech University

[ **Send me to more campuses like these** ](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zhfg06n6sqkiakoeq326rgk0jprjffci19t91pe8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0clj6aoj0shh2bs) These are big-time schools with leaders of the future. If you and I can draw hundreds of students to each speech, that would provide a big boost to campus conservative groups. Will there be protests? I hope so! But there will also be a whole lot of new students who are inspired to join our conservative cause. **Every college student you and I release from the left’s clutches represents a huge victory for our cause.** As those angry, violent protesters make clear, the left has an iron grip on many in the younger generation these days. They’re crawling out of the liberals’ roach motels to support far-left, all-out socialist candidates and causes. Yet many young men and women long to break free of all this nonsense -- they really do crave the truth. And you and I must help them. I’m doing my part, starting with this spring’s campus tour. **[I hope you’ll help me by supporting my friends at the Leadership Institute today.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zu4cpt7piflc2a20et52dcsihfnrjpcdfh975eb8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0clj6aoj0shh2bs)** The more such powerful events conservatives generate, the more you and I gain a foothold and our ideas spread -- and, of course, the more the left freaks out. **[Help me make it happen!](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zntdtqrjs4aagmggdskstbbfbos6vph3aq82f4j0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0clj6aoj0shh2bs)** Let’s save America, **Ann Coulter**
Author and Columnist P.S. Look out campus lefties -- here I come! By supporting my friends at the Leadership Institute today, you’ll help sponsor a major, timely campus tour for me. I’m excited by the opportunity to make campus leftists squirm and inspire more students to join us. **[Will you help me get out there right now?](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zubkbjbqutr37ppe1kgmafuubfgu2q16r732futo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0clj6aoj0shh2bs)** [ **Support my friends at the Leadership Institute** ](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zkn9kc2eob7qnb930tg95q6ki640da57hcuuv3o0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0clj6aoj0shh2bs)

You may have heard of us on talk radio, social media, YouTube, podcasts, or even on _Fox News_ because of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—like our free online courses. __ And though we’re best known for educating Americans about the Constitution and founding principles through these free courses, one of our most popular courses has been about a famous _British_ author—C.S. He is one of my absolute favorite authors because... ...While you may know him for his landmark _Chronicles of Narnia_ series, he was also a brilliant philosopher, writer, and Christian apologist. That’s why we decided to develop this online course. Since launching **“[An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zv311k7hrafko0o1rppil74r1gqinlfc6gepujqo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0clj6aoj7clh2bs),” **we’ve received an outpouring of thanks for offering a course that covers the breadth and scope of Lewis’ writings. So, I’m pleased to announce that the C.S. Lewis course is available on DVD for your home library. You can also give it as a gift or use it in a small group, such as a Bible study or book club. We only made a few of these special sets, so get this premium edition of **“[An Introduction to C.S. Given how popular this course is, the DVD box set won’t last long. Reserve your DVD set now using this secure link, while they last: [**https://secure.hillsdale.edu/be-the-first-to-get-hillsdales-new-c-s-lewis-dvd-set/**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3kesqu3bnoo4am8p33glqoqnl6am147b02lbm3o_rp22sh2s8i66pb0clj6aoj7clh2bs) Warm regards, Bill Gray Class of 2001 Associate Vice President of National Donor Outreach Hillsdale College

Fellow Conservative: Senate Conservatives Fund is proud to endorse State Attorney General **Eric Schmitt** for the U.S. Senate in Missouri.
Eric is a tough, principled constitutional conservative who has fought for the rights of individuals against anti-American, anti-family elites colluding against them. During his tenure as Missouri’s Attorney General, Schmitt has been _everywhere_.
✓ When Democrats manipulated 2020 election rules, Schmitt leaped into the fray, leading other state attorneys general to support election integrity lawsuits in Pennsylvania and Texas.
✓ When school boards tried to force students to wear masks against their parents’ objections, Schmitt took them to court on behalf of kids, families, and _**true**_ science.
✓ When Big Tech firms colluded to cancel conservatives from their platforms, Schmitt launched one of the nation’s most extensive investigations into their discriminatory business practices. **[Please join us by making a generous contribution to his grassroots campaign today!](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z0lotqqqoes3efurgvupp0agogtvd3scl56p9qag_rp22sh2s8i66pb0clj6aoj6c3h2bs)**
✓ When woke activists attacked a Missouri high school football coach for leading his players in prayer before a game, Schmitt defended the coach and made clear to school officials that he did nothing wrong under the law or the Constitution.
✓ Schmitt was also the first Attorney General to sue the Chinese Communist Party and the Wuhan Institute of Virology for their criminal negligence, coverups, and lies stemming from the origins of the Covid-19 pandemic.
These were all _**fights of choice**_ by Eric Schmitt. He didn’t have to wage them, and there were plenty of reasons not to. Big donors and the media don’t like culture warriors, don’t like holding leftists accountable.

But Eric Schmitt doesn’t work for _them_ – he works for the people. As Attorney General, he put Missouri families first. And in the Senate, he will put _America first_.
**[Please help send Eric Schmitt to the U.S. Senate.](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zm1gdja9ain00rjgt4ltfl9bpsq2uvsh9anke6e8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0clj6aoj6c3h2bs)**
The most important job for senators in 2023 won’t be passing bills – not with Joe Biden in the White House for two more years. No, it will be _investigations_ – subpoenaing documents, deposing witnesses, finding whistleblowers, and holding hearings. And we need a fighter like Eric Schmitt to do it.
For all Biden’s scandals, **there's much we still don't know about** :
▶︎ Hunter Biden’s shady business dealings.
▶︎ The border crisis and the location of illegal immigrants.
▶︎ Anthony Fauci’s role in the development of Covid-19.
▶︎ The FBI’s targeting of parents as “domestic terrorists.”
▶︎ White House collusion with Big Tech on censoring conservatives.
**[Let's find the truth. Support Eric Schmitt today!](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zm470v7mn64aa9d0pku5nq2t9h3vlbjnmv3q2sig_rp22sh2s8i66pb0clj6aoj6c3h2bs)**
No one will pursue the truth more doggedly than Eric Schmitt. He will join Rand Paul, Ron Johnson, and others in uncovering the facts about how Joe Biden, the Democrats, and the media are trying to steal our freedom and destroy everything that made America great.
Join SCF in supporting Schmitt in Missouri’s Senate race this year – in the primary and the general. He is precisely what we need in Washington right now: _**a fighter, a truth-teller, and a defender of America’s Constitution and culture.**_
**[Please contribute $25, $50, $100, or more to Eric Schmitt today!](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zancckfkt4hgdbeqg08l740p14ll9gc9feci3g5g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0clj6aoj6c3h2bs)**
SCF will pay all processing fees and transfer 100% of your contribution to his campaign.
Thank you for being part of our team and for doing so much to help build a conservative Senate. Sincerely,

Mary Vought Executive Director Senate Conservatives Fund

If you’re not familiar with CRT, it's the doctrine that all white people are oppressors, and that your skin color determines everything about you. Beyond this, _CRT teaches kids that America is evil to its core, and that everything that makes our country great, is secretly racist._** ** **_Then, what’s worse is that these radical school boards allow, hire, and encourage teachers who have been caught ACTIVELY recruiting children to become transgender._** And friend, you may not have seen it happening at the time, but for too long Republicans have neglected local races and instead focused on "BIG" races for President, Governor, and Congress. But in the process, we’ve left room for people like George Soros to take over local governments all over the country, right under our noses. Now, with all this doom and gloom, it’s easy to feel defeated. **But I know, and Tucker Carlson knows that this fight is far from over... ** And we CAN take back our schools from the radical left. Will you rush in $17.76 to the 1776 Project PAC as we prepared to target more than 200 races this year?**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zbr7g4qeb6lqq6po7mu39hh3agl51f27bj5lu1mg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0clj6aoj6c9h2bs) [**DONATE $17.76 OR MORE TODAY!**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zgs2n67normao8rd109bfmra15f40lsloarj61m8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0clj6aoj6c9h2bs) Now, I’m guessing you’ve never heard of me before... **....But, I’d be willing to bet you’ve heard Tucker, Laura Ingraham, and Donald Trump Jr. ** I’ve had the chance to discuss my plan with them, and they all believe that _the 1776 Project PAC’s 3 R’s Campaign Battle Plan is a game-changer!_ Here’s what each of them said: **> >>> Tucker Carlson: "**Parents have almost no support, _but now they do_. The **_1776 Project PAC_** __ is a political action committee designed to help school boards and communities elect sane people.... If you're thinking of writing a check... Think of writing it to Ryan Girdusky." **> >>> Laura Ingraham: **"For all the parents out there looking to reclaim your local school boards from radical leftists, help is on the way, a new political action committee called the **_1776 Project_** is going to support school board candidates who oppose indoctrinating kids with things like Critical Race Theory." **> >>> Donald Trump Jr.: **"The **_1776 Project_** is the very first Political Action Committee of it's kind, specifically created to take on this sinister attack on our way of life from within our own communities by working to take local schools boards out of the hands of these America-hating radical liberals..." Democrats needed Republican votes to fund the government. Senate Republican leaders had the leverage to fight for real reforms - building a border wall, boosting U.S. energy production, defunding unconstitutional vaccine mandates.
And what did they do? **Nothing.**
Mitch McConnell and his lackeys not only worked with Democrats to pass the $1.5 trillion bill. They brought back earmarks, too - 4,000 of them! As usual, establishment Republicans sold out their principles, their constituents, and our children.
What did we get? More spending, more debt, and more fuel to the inflation fire.
_**You and I both know that these outrageous Senate votes will not change until the Senators do.**_
**[Let's dump the Senate establishment to save America!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60191554:6y9JjIoNg:m:1:3317145305:428A04AD043662577E5A729F1789D615:r)**

In 2022, we can stop the Washington Mono-Party by electing true conservatives to Senate seats across the country:
---
* **MO BROOKS** in Alabama;
* **JOSH MANDEL** in Ohio;
* **TED BUDD** in North Carolina;
* **ADAM LAXALT** in Nevada; and
* Senators **MIKE LEE** , **RAND PAUL** , and **RON JOHNSON**.

---
Fighting, principled conservatives like them - joining America First leaders like Ted Cruz, Josh Hawley, and others - can change the Senate, Washington, and America.
SCF exists to leverage activist energy around the country and concentrates it on the most critical Senate races every cycle. This year, these races will determine not only whether the Senate goes Republican or Democrat but whether it will even matter.
**[Help us stop the endless Senate Sellouts by supporting SCF and our priority candidates today!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60191554:6y9JjIoNg:m:1:3317145305:428A04AD043662577E5A729F1789D615:r)**
_You can donate directly to multiple candidates with one transaction, and SCF will pay all processing fees so those candidates can spend 100% of your contributions on voter contact._
If moderate Republicans take these seats, conservatives will be left on the outside looking in, regardless of which party wins the majority. Only by nominating and electing tough, tenacious patriots will they have a chance to take on the Swamp next year.
**[Let 's make this latest sellout the last one we ever see.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60191554:6y9JjIoNg:m:1:3317145305:428A04AD043662577E5A729F1789D615:r)**

We’re proud that Jocelyn’s work to defend the will of the people and champion democracy is being recognized alongside President Zelenskyy, Congresswoman Cheney, and other courageous pro-democracy warriors.
It underscores that defending democracy truly is a team effort. It takes every one of us - every voter, every election official, every citizen across Michigan, the country, the globe - for this nonpartisan pro-democracy coalition to succeed.

Please join us in celebrating this award, which recognizes the importance of democracy, by redoubling our efforts to protect and defend it against the conspiracy theorists, election deniers, and just plain liars who seek to upend the will of the people to further their partisan and personal goals.

---
| When Newt Gingrich appeared on Sean Hannity's radio show Tuesday, both deeply respected conservative leaders encouraged 6th District voters to send Jake Evans to Congress in the 6th District, calling Jake a tough, Make America Great Again conservative who has the talent to make a difference in Washington. "There's somebody running for your old seat that I know would be an amazing congressman from Georgia, and his name is Jake Evans," Hannity said to the former speaker of the House. "Look, he's an America First conservative, he's a Make America Great Again, Save America conservative. ... He'll fight back on inflation, these crazy economic policies, these insane energy policies, these open border policies." Gingrich responded that he's coming back to Atlanta on Friday to support Jake's campaign. "I support Jake Evans 100 percent," Gingrich said. "I believe so deeply he's the kind of honest, straightforward, very smart but very tough person who, I think, will be a leader for the whole country, will do a great job for Georgia. He has exactly the core values that I think every conservative favors."

subject: My Lawsuit

body:
Peter, The Deep State is trying to kick me off the ballot. Despite donating millions to my opponents, they know they can't beat me in a fair election. So, they do what Deep State Elites do best - they try to change the rules to benefit them. They're trying to prevent me from winning before the election starts! All because I supported the right to peacefully protest the election stolen from Donald Trump in 2020. Frankly, I'm worried that without your help, they might succeed. **[That's why I'm asking for your help today with a donation of $25, $50, or $100 so I can fight back and continue to run for re-election as a Member of the United States Congress.](http://asg.vervemail9.com/ct/60193613:6WCcQIoNn:m:1:3103520637:DCC1046655144BAC2BD155C7F66039A5:r "That’s why I’m asking for your help
today with a donation of $25, $50, or $100 so I can fight back and continue to run for re-election as a Member of the United States Congress.")** Believe me when I say this is a coordinated effort from the D.C. Lobbyists and Washington elites who fear that I'm encouraging freedom-loving Americans to question every spending bill, unconstitutional mandate, and the socialist program they try to force upon us. [](http://asg.vervemail9.com/ct/60193613:6WCcQIoNn:m:1:3103520637:DCC1046655144BAC2BD155C7F66039A5:r "Video")I'm fighting to stop the border invasion, their defund agenda, and their new gun control measures, and this is how they intend to stop me. The deck has been so stacked against me that I had to file a lawsuit to stop this charade. I will probably have to take it all the way to the Supreme Court to win. **Fighting their fraudulent lawsuit could cost me hundreds of thousands of dollars.** That's money I won't be able to use to get my message out to the voters in my district. And I'm worried even if I'm successful in stopping their charade, I won't have enough to ensure victory at the ballot box. **[I'm not going to lie - the D.C. Cabal and their minions have got me over a barrel. That's why I desperately need your help today to ensure I can defend my right to be on the ballot AND then win the November election. Can you chip in $50, $100, or $500 to help me fend off this new attack?](http://asg.vervemail9.com/ct/60193613:6WCcQIoNn:m:1:3103520637:DCC1046655144BAC2BD155C7F66039A5:r "I’m not going to lie – the D.C. Cabal and their minions have got me over a barrel. That’s why I desperately need your help
today to ensure I can defend my right to be on the ballot AND then win the November election. Can you chip in $50, $100, or $500 to help me fend off
this new attack?")** It should worry you how hard they are trying to keep America First Conservatives like me off the ballot. These Leftists know we're making a difference in Congress, and it frightens them. Other states have blocked this type of ridiculous lawsuit, but I'm the Left's number one target, so I have to keep fighting. **[If you value the work that I've been able to accomplish, then I need you to dig deep. If I'm going to fend off this legal challenge AND win my election, it's going to require you to help me with a donation of $100, $500, or $1,000.](http://asg.vervemail9.com/ct/60193613:6WCcQIoNn:m:1:3103520637:DCC1046655144BAC2BD155C7F66039A5:r "If
you value the work that I’ve been able to accomplish, then I need you to dig deep. If I’m going to fend off this legal challenge AND win
my election, it’s going to require you to help me with a donation of $100, $500, or $1,000.")** The one silver lining I can see is that if they're working this hard to stop me from returning to Congress, then they're scared of what I might expose next--like how much Joe Biden is indebted to China. Our America First agenda is resonating and will bring true change to our country which is why I must continue to remain a Member of Congress. But it's only going to work if I can stop this legal challenge IMMEDIATELY. **[Please help me today.](http://asg.vervemail9.com/ct/60193613:6WCcQIoNn:m:1:3103520637:DCC1046655144BAC2BD155C7F66039A5:r "Please help me today.")** Thank you. God Bless America.
Marjorie Taylor Greene
Congresswoman (R-GA)

| Peter, I’m often asked what’s the most difficult aspect of teaching. It’s not grading papers or waking up at 6AM or even earlier – for me, it was losing students to gun violence. **In Maryland, firearms are tied as the second leading cause of death in people aged 17 and under.** Gun violence against young people not only robs kids of their futures, but also strips families, friends, and classmates of their loved ones only to be replaced with a deep sense of insecurity and loss. From the school shootings in Baltimore City to Great Mills to Catonsville, we’re seeing that it’s long past time to make Maryland a national leader in bold gun reform and reimagining public safety. From strengthening Maryland’s child access prevention law to investing in community organizations like Safe Streets Baltimore, we need a visionary and comprehensive approach to uplifting our neighborhoods. We must reimagine public safety and invest in initiatives and measures that prioritize racial justice. I am honored to have been named one of Moms Demand Action's 2022 Gun Sense Candidates for my work in gun violence prevention. As Maryland’s next governor, stopping gun violence will be a top priority because everyone deserves to feel safe and protected at school, at home, and in their community. body:
Fellow Conservative:

There is an old saying in politics: If you're taking flak, it means you're over the target. And right now, the Left is desperate to shoot down the Conservative Partnership Institute's growing squadron of razor-sharp organizations.
First, The New Yorker did a hit-piece on the American Accountability Foundation, the oversight research group we helped launch last year. Since AAF opened its doors, it has unearthed more scandals and disqualifying outrages about Joe Biden's nominees than any organization in
Washington.
The headline read, "The Slime Machine Targeting Dozens of Biden Nominees." We figure that translates as "The Incredibly Effective Researchers Exposing Biden's Incompetent Extremists."
It was AAF who first uncovered Judge Ketanji Brown Jackson's pattern of leniency toward convicted child molesters and sexual predators. And it was AAF that exposed and helped defeat:
❌ Comptroller nominee Saule Omarova, because she was an honest-to-goodness communist!
❌ Federal Reserve nominee Sarah Bloom Raskin, who wanted to fight climate change by denying banking services to the energy industry.
❌ David Chipman, the gun-grabber Biden tapped to run the Bureau of Alcohol Tobacco and Firearms.
The only reason the Left is attacking AAF and its president - the intrepid Tom Jones - is that he's beating them!
Please support CPI today so we can help programs like AAF shine more light on those seeking power.
And so is Cleta Mitchell in her vital project, the Election Integrity Network. EIN is crushing all expectations. Their state summits attract hundreds of activists and give them the tools to win America's fight for free and fair elections.
So it was only a matter of time before Cleta got a hit piece, too. Hers was in The Guardian. But the funny thing is that every supposedly "scary" thing EIN is doing is objectively good. Look at these quotes:
✅ "There was a large focus on recruiting precinct officials to watch the polls and all of the other processes associated with elections."
✅ "How to protect vulnerable voters from leftist activists."
✅ "Monitoring voting equipment and systems."
Citizen oversight? Accountability? Transparency? No wonder the Left is so upset!
Please help us expand the Election Integrity Network with a tax-deductible gift to CPI today.
Like AAF, EIN tells the truth to Americans sick of being lied to by woke socialists who run our government, corporations, and media.
CPI is proud to have helped Tom Jones and Cleta Mitchell score so many victories quickly in their new projects. And we're just as proud of the Left's outrage! The Woke Establishment is coming after these groups for one reason: because they are effective!
The smartest, toughest, most battle-hardened conservatives know where to come to start winning. With your support, these victories are just the beginning.
Thank you for considering this important request.

For Freedom,

Jim DeMintCPI Chairman

| PRESS RELEASE: DIEHL AGREES TO PARTICIPATE IN TWO PRE-PRIMARY DEBATES
Geoff Diehl, Republican candidate for Governor, announced today that he will agree to participate in two pre-primary debates with any other Republican gubernatorial candidate who secures enough certified signatures and convention votes to appear on the September primary ballot along with him.
Diehl's campaign has consistently said that Diehl would participate in debates as soon as any other challengers paid their required convention fee, submitted more than 10,000 certified signatures, and secured more than 15% of the vote at the convention.
Diehl paid a required fee of $25,000 to participate in the MassGOP nominating convention in December 2021. The campaign has already secured pledges of far more than 15% of convention delegates in order to place Diehl's name on the primary ballot, and today the Secretary of State's office confirmed that Diehl has more than 10,000 certified signatures from voters, which were all collected by volunteers.
According to Diehl's campaign, Howie Carr and Jeff Kuhner have both agreed to each host one-hour debates on their respective radio shows in July or August, before the state primary election.

Peter,

Gun violence prevention isn’t an issue I take lightly.

As Florida’s Commissioner of Agriculture, I’ve fought for common-sense gun safety policies. I worked to bring accountability to concealed weapons licensing, added new oversight measures, and raised awareness around gun violence in our state.

That’s why, as of this week, I’ve officially received the Moms Demand Action Gun Sense Candidate distinction — because I’ve been a fierce advocate in the fight for gun violence prevention, and I’m ready to continue my record of advocacy as your next Governor. Can you chip in $20 to help me do it? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-apr-2022?refcode=421mda]

| | MARQUETTE, Mich. — My opponent responded to my comments about his actions and votes by name-calling and labeling, but not by addressing the topic at hand. Rep. Bergman called me a radical leftist. Don’t be distracted and fooled; this isn’t based on any facts about my record or what I stand for. His reply misses the point, again. My independent political positions are based entirely on what’s best for our district, state, and Nation. We could label each other all day. I’m not interested. Let’s get honest with the constituency about who we are, where we stand and debate the issues.
* I support universal healthcare, modernization of the VA, public education funding, livable wages, criminal justice reform and the environment.
* We should also be careful with spending and only fund effective and efficient federal programs, including addressing our crumbling and inadequate infrastructure.
* I support law enforcement, first responders, frontline workers, our troops and national security.
* I believe in choice and liberty.
* I support the Second Amendment and believe fatalities by firearm — especially deaths by suicide — should be treated as a public health crisis.
* I support small businesses, job creation and a thriving economy
* I am concerned about government overreach in our everyday private lives. Our Nation is dependent on our independence, but we will only thrive through our interdependence on each other.

---
---
**_If this sounds "radical" to my opponent, it may be more of a reflection on him than me._** What label is appropriate for someone who identifies problems and offers real solutions that create a better future? Hard-working families in this district deserve an honest conversation about the issues, not more labeling. I won’t tow the partisan line when it isn’t moving us forward, and I will join across the aisle when appropriate. I’m asking voters to consider each candidate’s character and the principles by which they live. Those are the perimeters that will quickly identify how we’ll vote. At the end of the day, I’m primarily a grandfather who’s qualified for Congress and deeply concerned about the direction Jack Bergman has taken our district and country — backward. Some politicians pull the country to the left; others pull us to the right. I strive to lead us forward.

Our progress by the numbers

---
Friend – I want to explain what we've achieved together by the numbers:

In the 2012 election, Democrats won the congressional popular vote by **1.4 million votes**. But because of gerrymandering, Republicans won **33 more seats** in Congress.

In Pennsylvania, for example, Democrats were gerrymandered into just **five seats (out of 18)** despite getting significantly more total statewide votes in congressional elections. But in this redistricting cycle, the Pennsylvania Democratic candidates can reasonably compete for as many as **10 seats!**

We've seen similar changes in North Carolina, where Democrats were packed into just **four seats (out of 13)** in 2012, and Michigan, where they were packed into **five (out of 14)**. In the 2022 elections, Republican and Democratic candidates will be able to compete for _**half**_ the congressional seats in each state. | [Help us keep working
toward fair redistricting >>](https://click.everyaction.com/k/44386368/341359203/1731801576?&amount=20&refcode=20220421.1r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY4ZjcwMGYwLTg3YzEtZWMxMS05OTdlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=bh1wqbEP0FaQiClalYGHaqE-ccr4MtRBvJyR6Vqb5kk=)

name: Sheriff Joe Lombardo
subject: Veteran. Current Sheriff. Lifelong Republican.
body:
I wanted to take some time to write this personal email...
---
| | | | | | |
---
|
---
| Peter,
As the most critical midterm election year in Nevada's history continues to pick up steam, I wanted to take some time to write this personal email and tell you why I believe I have the proven leadership needed to get our state back on track.
My call to serve began in the armed forces. I was proud to represent my country in the United States Army, the National Guard, and the Army Reserve. Doing so made me believe in a purpose greater than myself, and I realized I had a calling to protect the country, the state, and the communities I love.
So I continued to do just that, starting my career in law enforcement as an officer with the Las Vegas Metropolitan Police Department back in 1988. And after quickly rising through the ranks, I was eventually elected as Sheriff of Nevada's largest county - even as a Republican in a Democrat jurisdiction.
That brings me to this last point... I'm proud to say that I'm a lifelong Republican. While many told me I couldn't win all of Clark County with an "R" next to my name, I did just that - and was re-elected with 73% of the vote. I never wavered in my proud conservative values, even in the face of political pressure.
My constituents believed in my leadership abilities, and now thousands of folks just like you are believing in my run for Governor as well. That's been made loud and clear with record fundraising totals and polls that show us WINNING in November. YOU helped make those things happen.
Clearly, our mission here in the state of Nevada has a real shot at being successful on Election Day. But it's not going to be easy. This is going to take hard work, determination, and an entire team of dedicated supporters.
[With all of that being said, I wanted to see if you'd be willing to take just a minute today to support our campaign by either making a one-time donation or setting up a monthly, recurring contribution of any amount. ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001rDcbCe0O1QAdgWP487ouvUvxHSceCfVi5tY0OvxN-B7_GX1thHUU6QCQyFNuw40TB8uumRN42z1IZaa0nQUMuo_TTkVcGVNe0T9Coxd6D2hYhmSPywJMYX0FDuuit2hXNyX1LfGhD68dvermJsrBpz_FATE-8k5dGHRVY9iJonwNNomQk6Hxk4P1Rgrz4XcOmeSJcsP9vhCWEhkc9YkSjCWvCAh2Qg-LMQoIFzJy30Q=&c=R-oe_YLIL1g4DvB_x50PddZL6n6DxNLSU-PUhwXLZQxHMRjDBWK_uA==&ch=NHtAFuKzo2ZDs3ilyNo15vL-ZVAACZgLW26x4WtFQCzZnZuD95rq2w==)
As we work to provide law enforcement leadership for our state, this continued support really does make all the difference.
I can't thank you enough for taking this step today. Our current politicians in Carson City have a lack of communication, lack of leadership, lack of vision, and lack of direction... But with each day that we build momentum, we get closer and closer to taking Nevada back.
Let's keep our great state SAFE, Sheriff Joe Lombardo

I’m incredibly excited to share with you that I’m pregnant! Towqir and I, along with our family and friends, are overjoyed.

I’m so grateful for everyone who stood by us through this journey, and who I know will remain an incredible support system as our family grows.

I underwent over a year of fertility treatments, a miscarriage, and a medical abortion that saved my life. We need more people who have lived through these experiences, and who are advocating for progressive policies, to have a seat at the table in Washington.

**Now, I know that becoming a working mom, one of over 24 million in this country, will only strengthen my ability to fight for the change we need.**

But we cannot ignore the bias, conscious or not, that creeps into voters' minds when it comes to moms running for office.

Fathers with children at home have always been a mainstay in Congress, but today less than 6% of Congress is made up of moms with kids under the age of 18. It’s time we changed that.

subject: Craig & Whitmer
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Michael Brown for Governor • P
body:
Today I released a new ad calling out Jim Craig and Gretchen Whitmer for kneeling with radical Black Lives Matter activists. | | | |
---
| | | Peter:

This isn’t an easy email to write.

Today I released a new ad calling out Jim Craig and Gretchen Whitmer for _kneeling with radical Black Lives Matter activists_.

If you recall, BLM was chanting anti-police threats like “Pigs in a blanket, fry ‘em like bacon” and “What do we want? Dead cops!”

**Yet James Craig kneeled at a BLM protest to appease these radicals.**
---
| [ ](https://captainmikeformichigan.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d4c9e98e87232d3682c652313&id=d85e77132f&e=0636b97700)
---
|
---
| Craig’s actions are shocking and disappointing, but _not surprising_.

[**Earlier this year, he called Michigan State Police officers “weak kneed.”**](https://captainmikeformichigan.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d4c9e98e87232d3682c652313&id=160f6c2f21&e=0636b97700)

In a fundraising letter, Craig complained that his campaign announcement was overrun by protestors and he blamed Whitmer implying that she ordered state troopers to stand down.

“...we should have anticipated the _weak-kneed_ response from _Whitmer’s state troopers_ ,” Craig said in the letter.

[**Three times he referred to The Michigan State Police as “Whitmer’s state troopers.”**](https://captainmikeformichigan.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d4c9e98e87232d3682c652313&id=8a9ea84161&e=0636b97700)

It shows how out of touch Jim Craig is. The Michigan State Police is not the police force of the Governor. They are not “Governor Whitmer’s state troopers.”

When confronted about the letter, _Craig passed the buck_ and blamed one of his former campaign managers.

We deserve better.

Kneeling to appease BLM radicals?

Disparaging police officers as “weak kneed...underlings”?

Sounds like something out of a Democrat playbook, not from a Republican running for Governor.

Peter, I’d rather not have to call out an opponent like this, but this week _Jim Craig bragged that he is “the candidate to beat.”_ That’s pretty audacious, and I take that as a challenge.

**I’ll put my 34 years of leadership experience, my _military service_ , my _elective office_ experience, my energy, and my positions on the issues, against his any day of the week.**

And yes, if necessary, I’ll call out an opponent’s flaws or weaknesses. Voters need to know the truth so they can make an informed choice.

If you haven’t already, please visit my website and learn more about what I plan to do to fix Michigan. I’ve released comprehensive plans on [Public Safety](https://captainmikeformichigan.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d4c9e98e87232d3682c652313&id=5b2c43d6db&e=0636b97700), [Government Transparency](https://captainmikeformichigan.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d4c9e98e87232d3682c652313&id=84558046ca&e=0636b97700), and [Taxes](https://captainmikeformichigan.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d4c9e98e87232d3682c652313&id=5fb33ed56c&e=0636b97700) with more coming.

I want you to know who I am and what I stand for.

**I’ve driven over 1 million miles on Michigan roads and highways** , and know the state like the back of my hand. I’ve talked with fellow citizens from Monroe to Marquette, from Benton Harbor to Alpena, and many places in between.

We’re all crying out for a new direction in this state. We know the destruction that Gretchen Whitmer has caused with her lockdowns and mandates. _It’s time to turn things around and fix Michigan_.

I know I am the candidate that can deliver on that promise. **Together we will WIN the Governor’s race and return respect back to the citizens.**

Sincerely,

Michael Brown
Republican for Governor

| | Peter,
If we want to see actual change in our country, the reality is clear.

[**_Without action from grassroots Conservative supporters like yourself, America as we know it, is doomed_**](https://JaromeBellForCongress.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=998fb70d47f315dfa6664b71d&id=a12ac6e78b&e=af4b86f5c6).

I say this for multiple reasons. Right now Americans nationwide are suffering due to Democrat policies. We are facing record-high inflation, exploding gas prices, a wide-open Southern border, and instability overseas. This will continue **_unless_** leadership change is made in D.C.!

It may seem overwhelming and exhausting to think about this.
With a weak and clueless president in Joe Biden doing whatever he wants while Congress does NOTHING to keep him accountable, it’s easy to give up.

But giving up is **_NOT_** an option! [**_The America we love and cherish can be saved if we take action right now_**](https://JaromeBellForCongress.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=998fb70d47f315dfa6664b71d&id=050100cbd1&e=af4b86f5c6)!

74 million Americans rallied in support of Donald Trump in 2020! We must remember the positive energy and change made under Trump.

[**_This is why we need to focus on the upcoming midterm elections and secure a strong Republican majority_**](https://JaromeBellForCongress.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=998fb70d47f315dfa6664b71d&id=b30d8ad9f7&e=af4b86f5c6).

Then, Biden’s harmful policies will be **_STOPPED_** and the voices of Conservatives can actually be heard in D.C.!

While polling shows that Americans are waking up to the truth about the Democrat agenda, **_victory is not guaranteed_**. Pelosi and her Democrat establishment donors are spending **_millions_** to stop politicians like myself from being elected.

We cannot afford to wait until the week of the midterm election to start fighting. My campaign **_needs_** you to join in this fight _right now_.

Because of this, I ask you to pitch in $10, $20, $50, or $100 to my campaign today. [Can I count on you to take concrete action against the Left](https://JaromeBellForCongress.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=998fb70d47f315dfa6664b71d&id=50b0079728&e=af4b86f5c6)?
[**PITCH IN $10**
**PITCH IN $20**
**PITCH IN $50**
**PITCH IN $100**](https://JaromeBellForCongress.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=998fb70d47f315dfa6664b71d&id=d657935989&e=af4b86f5c6)
From the bottom of my heart, thank you for stepping up. Your support in this fight for America is **_incredibly_** important.

Respectfully,

**
Jarome Bell
Chief Petty Officer, Ret'd.
Republican Candidate for Congress**

P.S.: [To stop Biden from destroying America, Conservatives need to support the election of fearless Republicans like myself to Congress. It is _instrumental_ that we regain a majority in Congress to stop our country from falling apart. Donate **today** to take action against the Left! Thank you for your support](https://JaromeBellForCongress.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=998fb70d47f315dfa6664b71d&id=df4a335985&e=af4b86f5c6)!

body:
“If gun control worked, Chicago would be one of the safest cities in America.”
#

Friends -
Here’s an old favorite of the NRA:
_“If gun control worked, Chicago would be one of the safest cities in America.”_
They tweeted it again this weekend.
But here’s something they know full-well: the majority of the guns used in crimes committed in Chicago don’t come from Chicago. They come from states and cities with much weaker gun laws.
The guy who fired on the subway car in Brooklyn last week—he bought the gun used in his crime in Ohio.
The gun lobby knows this. They know that guns cross state lines just as easily as cars do, as President Obama once said.
This is why **federal legislation** to make our communities safer from gun violence is so important. It’s also why the NRA fights so hard to stop it.
Now here’s the truth:
Passing that legislation requires having enough leaders in Congress with the courage to act. That’s why we’re going to be very involved in supporting gun safety candidates this election cycle.
Gun violence is a winning issue—but keeping this issue front and center takes sustained efforts and substantial resources. The more races we can do that in, the more elected officials begin to reconsider their ties to the NRA. That’s especially true in a year that may otherwise be tough for Democrats.
So please. Help us win races on this issue. Help us change minds. Help us save lives.

name: Trump News HQ
subject: Future generations are counting on your response
body:
Please take time right now to review and complete Hillsdale College’s RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY Three-Point National Battle
[View this message in your browser](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zd6eohh57fviijtgn1illgou3mqkmmt7qmg84n3g_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk5p7atdge5p78d5jmeqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbrj2ddmejg70t9n68r62s32m4qb2tdmmop68s746gonfchl6urb3chieqo74tlgsv970sj2cpob4pjgsipm6o3i61j33c5lmgrreoj66jgb4pj0s2qm6o70mkoj3d9hmlp238h1e8he4933clg6aor5c3h64oh5u)
This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zp44at782oknj0losp5nrem8kjrl7rjbmplq82q0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0clhmao72c9h2bs) Dear Fellow American, Can you do me a favor? Please take time right now to review and complete Hillsdale College’s [**RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey**.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zbckrn4bhsc6p49ul0p06ebvsgsj31qetbldmk38_rp22sh2s8i66pb0clhmao72c9h2bs) My name is Bill Gray, and I’m the associate vice president of national donor outreach at Hillsdale College. It’s my responsibility to invite like-minded conservatives (like you!) to support Hillsdale. **I don’t use the word “battle” lightly, but with the stakes so high one must be blunt.** It’s clear to me that we are in a fight for the future of our nation—a fight against progressives who are targeting our youngest citizens. These so-called “progressives” seek to undermine traditional patriotism and ultimately transform American government and society. _The New York Times’_ recent “1619 Project” is the prime example of this effort to inject into the minds of our youngest citizens a biased distortion of our nation’s history. If you haven’t heard, the “1619 Project” places the founding of America in 1619, when the first slave arrived in Jamestown, rather than in 1776 when the Declaration of Independence proclaimed that “all men are created equal” and endowed by God with “unalienable rights.” **“Our democracy’s founding ideals,” the “1619 Project” proclaims, “were false when they were written.”** Outrageous! _The New York Times’_ stated goal with the “1619 Project” is to influence the curricula of K-12 schools nationwide. They teach young people that slavery—not freedom—is and always will be the central and defining idea of the American experience, making our country irredeemable. This project has garnered universal acclaim from the news media. In fact, the lead essayist just won a Pulitzer Prize! There are even talks about making the “1619 Project” into a feature film. **Given popular and widespread efforts like these, we should not be surprised that there is a decreasing sense of patriotism among younger Americans—and an increasing tendency to embrace socialism and other liberty-destroying ideas.** Education has become a battleground, and reviving a proper understanding of American history and government, especially among younger citizens, must be our** _most urgent priority._** Hillsdale College is at the forefront of this effort. **We are actively engaging the Left on the battlefield of education. And I need your help to make this effort even more effective.** Hillsdale is America’s most powerful advocate for intelligent and informed patriotism—our best defense against the loss of our liberty and insidious beliefs like socialism. We do this on our Michigan campus, with an undergraduate and graduate student body of over 1,500, and through education that reaches and teaches millions of citizens each year on behalf of liberty. And in response to new efforts such as the media-driven “1619 Project” that seek to turn the next generation of citizens against the principles of the Declaration of Independence and the U.S. Constitution, Hillsdale must expand this critical work—especially in 2020. As I said before, to fight and win this battle, Hillsdale needs your help right away. The FIRST step I need you to take right now is to complete the **RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY! Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey**. This national project seeks to make it clear that people in your state and nationwide still revere our founding principles of liberty, and refuse to let them be corrupted by those who hold America in contempt. **As _The New York Times’_ efforts make clear, powerful forces vehemently oppose this view of America, and their assault on our glorious history is taking place before our very eyes. ** _Our ongoing response, rooted in genuine learning, and proven to reach millions of citizens, must be escalated as quickly as possible._ And if, upon completing your Battle Plan, you feel a strong connection to Hillsdale’s work, then I urge you to please consider including a generous tax-deductible gift in support of expanding these efforts on behalf of liberty. Based on the costs of Hillsdale’s multiple educational programs—which I will outline fo**r you shortly—it has been determined that to fully implement this[RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zd46o7l6mgo6msap31htk4j4ia5uqa1j2l4rhvuo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0clhmao72c9h2bs)** for maximum impact, Hillsdale College must raise at least $1,016,700 within the next month. And unlike most colleges and universities that rely on federal funding and subsidies, EVERY PENNY of funding for Hillsdale’s educational outreach comes from the voluntary support of intelligent patriots like you. This is because Hillsdale College refuses EVEN ONE PENNY of state or federal taxpayer funding—even indirectly in the form of student grants or loans. That’s so important, I need to say it again—Hillsdale College refuses EVERY PENNY of government funding! **In this way, Hillsdale remains truly independent, avoiding unconstitutional regulations that would violate the College’s educational mission.** Hillsdale has built national support from hundreds of thousands of citizens. These intelligent patriots know that liberty in America is in trouble thanks to progressive control of our schools and institutions. And these citizens are determined to preserve our liberty—as I believe you are. These supporters give what they can, when they can—gifts of $25 or $50 or more, sometimes much more ... because they understand that every dollar given goes to reaching and teaching millions of people—including our nation’s youth—with genuine learning about liberty and the Constitution. The gift you choose to give today will determine whether Hillsdale can activate each component of the **[RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z6fqrj4cbqbh0ehgo0u9ul708l679i10lbdrv4r8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0clhmao72c9h2bs)** And this entire plan is tied to Hillsdale’s proven programs and publications that are educating millions of Americans right now. Here are the key aspects of Hillsdale’s plan for your review and feedback: **BATTLE PLAN POINT #1: Identify the Critical Concerns of Everyday Americans** I mentioned that our network of supporters that is hundreds of thousands of patriots strong—such a broad base of support gives us invaluable public-opinion data on what Americans are MOST concerned about given the current state of our nation. We are always eager to add new perspectives (like yours) that can make our work the most relevant and timely possible. **Your participation today will allow Hillsdale to strengthen our educational outreach efforts by targeting them where they’re needed most, on the areas of concern that matter most to the American people.** You were selected to be part of this effort based on your record of involvement in causes that strengthen America, AND because of Hillsdale’s confidence that you will respond quickly and honestly, lending your voice to our efforts to restore the Constitution. I’m counting on and very much looking forward to your survey response! **BATTLE PLAN POINT #2: Counter Progressive Teaching in America’s Schools** In this section we dig deep into Hillsdale’s proven educational outreach, and give you a sense of how we lead important conversations surrounding America’s history and founding principles—AND ask what YOU think about these efforts. And make no mistake—Hillsdale is uniquely qualified to drive this effort. Did you know that Hillsdale is one of only a few American colleges and universities that requires each student, regardless of major, to complete a one-semester course on the Constitution? This fact has earned the support of so many Americans who did not attend the College, and who have never even set foot on our campus—they understand that what we teach in our classrooms radiates all over America. Is this important to you? In 2012, Hillsdale began offering online courses _free of charge_ , because we see it as an effective way promote intelligent patriotism and civic virtue. We market the courses on social media and online to reach large audiences, especially younger Americans. The response has been tremendous—over 2.3 million citizens have taken one or more of our online courses. Do you think this is an effective means of reaching and teaching millions of Americans on behalf of liberty? We even have an online course that directly counters _The New York Times’_ “1619 Project.” This free course is called **“The Great American Story: A Land of Hope”** and presents an unbiased and complete account of America’s past. To me this is a great example of why these free courses are needed: They safeguard the country, through education, against the damage to liberty inflicted by the Left. And what do you think about sending a free monthly digest of liberty, to millions of people? This newsletter is called _Imprimis_ , and it features speeches delivered at Hillsdale events by prominent scholars, journalists, and policymakers, focused on political, economic, historic, and cultural topics from a constitutional viewpoint. _Imprimis_ is America’s most widely-circulated publication in support of liberty, reaching more households and businesses than either the _Wall Street Journal_ or the “fake news” _New York Times_. Issues covering topics such as “Rediscovering the Wisdom of American History” and “Shall We Defend our Common History?” set _Imprimis_ apart. The publication is as a powerful counterbalance to the biased media outlets that pursue narrow, ideologically driven distortions of history. (If you’re not yet an _Imprimis_ subscriber, we’ll be happy to sign you up as soon as we hear from you.) **BATTLE PLAN POINT #3: Restore Excellence to K-12 Schools** In this section we explore how Hillsdale College is reshaping American K-12 education, especially through our Barney Charter School Initiative, which helps launch and guide classical K-12 charter schools nationwide, teaching thousands of K-12 students. These schools all have a strong civics curriculum. The curriculum provides young Americans with a solid grounding in our nation’s history, our limited constitutional government, and economics. In doing so, Hillsdale provides communities with a practical model of how schools can best serve students and the country. **Sustained by our supporters, Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative has assisted in the founding of more than 20 classical K-12 charter schools in 11 states, with approximately 12,000 students enrolled. And more of these K-12 schools are opening each year.** Do you support this effort to set a new standard for K-12 education and give young Americans a proper education? Hillsdale also launched a new initiative to send pocket Constitutions to thousands of elementary and junior high schools. We ship them with a promise to send as many pocket Constitutions as their schools need. **The response has been astounding.** We’ve now sent out more than 500,000 pocket Constitutions across the country, and we receive more requests every week. Does this effort to restore the Constitution to K-12 schools sound like a good idea to you? As you select your answers, I believe you will find that Hillsdale’s educational outreach is a powerful way to confront and ultimately overcome the progressive forces that seek to instill in young people the ruinous idea that America stands for slavery, not freedom. I know you love this country, and I hope you will partner with Hillsdale in defending America through education—education aimed at citizens of all ages nationwide. The first step is getting your thoughts on our **[RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zerd20bqlvnkt04mp8fh47u2jlr2uj3i9hsgp9r8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0clhmao72c9h2bs)**
With your response you will represent your state as part of a major sampling of citizen opinion that can help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views and concerns of mainstream Americans—views that we can make available to policymakers and opinion leaders when we discuss the Left’s agenda, and use to strengthen our educational outreach efforts. What Hillsdale needs now is YOU—your thoughtful input on the work we’re doing, and your generous support to expand our work. **So please complete the[Battle Plan Survey](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvph3ojlsecs0noe31ben2upsb6e71o6nvap2kco_rp22sh2s8i66pb0clhmao72c9h2bs) today.**
When you give to Hillsdale and share your opinions, you will join a dedicated and growing team of intelligent patriots, who always step up when the time comes to defend America against the progressives’ attack on American history and liberty. Thank you for your commitment to liberty in America. Warm regards,
Bill Gray
Assoc. Vice President of National Donor Outreach
Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 **P.S**. We are in a battle for the future of America, because the Left is determined to transform our country ... by fundamentally changing how history is taught to young people. Education is the battlefield, and Hillsdale College urgently needs you standing with us to support and sustain our efforts. With your help, we can continue to reach and teach millions of citizens of all ages, especially the youngest Americans, with the principles of liberty underlying the Constitution. Please complete **[RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY! Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zh4co5nuh0ot6e5jempqmt6svjpemt3chq8l8krg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0clhmao72c9h2bs)** to shape Hillsdale College’s defense of America against the progressive assault on history. Your response is needed within five days so we can finalize plans to expand our educational outreach on behalf of liberty.

body:
I am rolling out my environmental policy for L.A., and I hope I can have your support by the end of this email.

Team, I am rolling out **[my environmental policy for L.A.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44395756/341396888/1454842613?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85NDYxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNTAwNjAyYy1hM2MxLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=v4gKHOIZP3YQRYOw9gNZLfDIOElsrE-Ldv2tjQm1RFI=&emci=82db3884-f0c0-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=0500602c-a3c1-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2429742)** , and I'd like to share my vision for a greener city with you below if you have a few minutes.

The climate crisis is one of the greatest challenges facing our city, and communities of color have borne the brunt of these emergencies. Substantially reducing our carbon footprint is non-negotiable, and it's an opportunity for Los Angeles to rebuild its infrastructure and invest in a more equitable future for all.

I know our city has what it takes to address the climate crisis and advance equity. Here's how:

**1\. End the City’s Contribution to the Climate Problem**

I affirm L.A.'s goal of achieving 100 percent clean power by 2035. As mayor, I will expand the network of electric vehicle (EV) charging stations throughout L.A., create jobs installing and maintaining stations, and accelerate the transition to electrify all city-owned bus fleets. We will invest in the chronically under-funded Vision Zero project to create safer streets, expand the city's open streets frequency and locations — like CicLAvia — and transform our streets to be safer, greener, and more walkable.

**2\. Ensure All Communities Thrive In the Clean Economy**

Green jobs are the future. I will promote a comprehensive, regional approach to workforce development – anchored by deep partnerships with labor, community-based organizations, workers, educational institutions, and every sector of the clean economy. We also need to leverage public dollars to require strong wage, benefit, safety, and skill standards for all climate investments. I will work to ensure fossil fuel workers affected by the transition receive the new jobs, health care, pensions, and wage support they deserve.

**3\. Build Healthy and Resilient Communities**

We must expand access to amenities that improve the health and resiliency of our communities while reducing exposure to toxic and hazardous sites. That's why I will work to end neighborhood oil drilling, expand Green Zones, make our food systems more resilient, and give impacted communities a seat at the table.

**4\. Secure a Sustainable Water Future**

California is now experiencing the worst drought in recorded history. We need to invest in programs that help Angelenos reduce their water use and support low-income residents with on-site repairs. We will expand and accelerate incentives and programs to help Angelenos maximize on-site rainwater capture, increase groundwater recharge, and more.

**5\. Protect and Expand Open Space for All Angelenos**

Protecting open space and creating more parks is not in conflict with meeting our housing goals. We must, and will, do both. As mayor, I will ensure that L.A. protects and expands its natural environments. We must also eliminate the use of toxic chemicals in our parks and open spaces, expand the use of California native plants and trees on city-run properties, and incentivize residents and businesses to do the same.

**[The climate crisis can't be summed up in one email and neither can our plan to aggressively address it. My full, comprehensive Environment Platform can be found at this link. I hope you will take the time to read and endorse our vision for a greener, healthier, and more prosperous L.A.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44395757/341396889/1454842613?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85NDYxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNTAwNjAyYy1hM2MxLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=v4gKHOIZP3YQRYOw9gNZLfDIOElsrE-Ldv2tjQm1RFI=&emci=82db3884-f0c0-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=0500602c-a3c1-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2429742)**

clean_body: I am rolling out my environmental policy for L.A., and I hope I can have your support by the end of this email. Team, I am rolling out , and I'd like to share my vision for a greener city with you below if you have a few minutes. The climate crisis is one of the greatest challenges facing our city, and communities of color have borne the brunt of these emergencies. Substantially reducing our carbon footprint is non-negotiable, and it's an opportunity for Los Angeles to rebuild its infrastructure and invest in a more equitable future for all. I know our city has what it takes to address the climate crisis and advance equity. Here's how: 1\. End the City’s Contribution to the Climate Problem I affirm L.A.'s goal of achieving 100 percent clean power by 2035. As mayor, I will expand the network of electric vehicle (EV) charging stations throughout L.A., create jobs installing and maintaining stations, and accelerate the transition to electrify all city-owned bus fleets. We will invest in the chronically under-funded Vision Zero project to create safer streets, expand the city's open streets frequency and locations — like CicLAvia — and transform our streets to be safer, greener, and more walkable. 2\. Ensure All Communities Thrive In the Clean Economy Green jobs are the future. I will promote a comprehensive, regional approach to workforce development – anchored by deep partnerships with labor, community-based organizations, workers, educational institutions, and every sector of the clean economy. We also need to leverage public dollars to require strong wage, benefit, safety, and skill standards for all climate investments. I will work to ensure fossil fuel workers affected by the transition receive the new jobs, health care, pensions, and wage support they deserve. 3\. Build Healthy and Resilient Communities We must expand access to amenities that improve the health and resiliency of our communities while reducing exposure to toxic and hazardous sites. That's why I will work to end neighborhood oil drilling, expand Green Zones, make our food systems more resilient, and give impacted communities a seat at the table. 4\. Secure a Sustainable Water Future California is now experiencing the worst drought in recorded history. We need to invest in programs that help Angelenos reduce their water use and support low-income residents with on-site repairs. We will expand and accelerate incentives and programs to help Angelenos maximize on-site rainwater capture, increase groundwater recharge, and more. 5\. Protect and Expand Open Space for All Angelenos Protecting open space and creating more parks is not in conflict with meeting our housing goals. We must, and will, do both. As mayor, I will ensure that L.A. protects and expands its natural environments. We must also eliminate the use of toxic chemicals in our parks and open spaces, expand the use of California native plants and trees on city-run properties, and incentivize residents and businesses to do the same. clean_body: It’s time for the communities that got locked up during marijuana prohibition to share in the wealth now being created the Commonwealth’s growing cannabis market: | | | | | Team, In 2017, Massachusetts made a commitment to equity in our adult-use cannabis law, but since then, fewer than 7% of Massachusetts cannabis licenses have gone to low-income entrepreneurs and businesses owned by people of color. I’m proud to share that this month, the Massachusetts Senate passed key legislation I’ve been working on to level the industry playing field and help members of communities disproportionately harmed by marijuana prohibition and enforcement gain an ownership stake in the state’s growing cannabis market. I'm thrilled to see this bill — a major breakthrough for racial equity — move forward. I’ve been a longtime advocate for social equity in emerging industries, and it’s a mantle I’ll continue to carry as your next Governor. We can and must do more to ensure everyone has equal access to Massachusetts’ cannabis market. clean_body: Did you see her recent ad? Peter. | | | Hey team BTE! Did you see Jamie McLeod-Skinner for Congress on TV? Her ad came out just last week and it gained a lot of traction! (In case you missed it, here it is!) Jamie was able to pull this off because of all of the support from individuals like you. Kurt Schrader, Jamie’s opponent, on the other hand was able to push out his TV ads by accepting corporate funds. Jamie refuses to accept even a penny of corporate donations - her entire race has been built from the ground up by grassroots donors and she stands by that. ---
**I promise to _never_ tire in my fight for a better and safer Florida, but the GOP has already poured _millions_ into the state to keep it permanently red. We're gaining ground and we can win – but in a race this tight, it’ll all come down to resources. So please:**
**[_If you believe in me and my story, will you join our grassroots movement today? Chip in $5 or more to help defeat Rubio, flip Florida blue and expand our Senate majority!_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44396845/341401816/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2987-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MjM3MjZiNy1hNWMxLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3I_O7L2pp8TN3T26Avfx8AzF1QpFDU4VvJBJJ7qf-VM=)**
