Friend: This is a longer and especially important email about why I'm running for Senate. It's important for me to share my story with you and tell you why this campaign means so much to me. I hope you'll give it a read.
I was raised in Jacksonville, Florida – and I've got to say, when you grow up in the South poor, Black and female, you've _got_ to have faith. It's something I learned from my parents. Mom was a maid, Dad was a janitor, and my goodness they worked _hard._ And although we didn't have a lot of money – although life was tough sometimes – we had each other. We had love. We had _faith. _I've carried that spirit with me my entire career.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44396846/341401817/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2987-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MjM3MjZiNy1hNWMxLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3I_O7L2pp8TN3T26Avfx8AzF1QpFDU4VvJBJJ7qf-VM=)
That faith that things can get better, that we can do some good in the world, inspired me to get into public service. In fact, my mom used to say to me, "Never grow tired of doing good, Val – _never_ tire." And so for me, growing tired was never an option. It's what pushed me to become the first in my family to graduate college. It's also what pushed me to serve 27 years in the Orlando Police Department, where eventually I became the first woman to lead the department. And it pushed me to run for Congress and represent my community.
**[I will never tire of the opportunities to do good or the challenges to tackle before me, and I'm asking you to do the same. Pitch in a contribution of $5 or more before my midnight deadline to help me defeat Marco Rubio, win in Florida and defend our Senate majority.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44396847/341401818/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2987-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MjM3MjZiNy1hNWMxLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3I_O7L2pp8TN3T26Avfx8AzF1QpFDU4VvJBJJ7qf-VM=)**
_Never tire._ These are the words that resonate in my mind each and every day that I serve the people of Florida's 10th District in Congress. They've stuck with me as I've fought to put an end to gun violence, especially as the horror of that violence struck our district at Pulse Nightclub in Orlando. We mourned, deeply. But we resolved to fight for change, to never tire – and I won't stop until long-overdue action on gun violence is finally realized.
_Never tire,_ I said to myself as I took on a habitual offender who occupied the most powerful office in the world: President Donald Trump. Unlike some in Washington, I _never tire_ of standing up for what I believe is right, and I carried that with me as I fought to impeach him, because no one is above the law.
This is my story, friend: Only in America can a little Black girl, the daughter of a maid and a janitor growing up in the South in the '60s, have a story so filled with opportunities like these. Now, I'm ready to meet a new moment, to do more good for Floridians.** ****I am ready to be the next U.S. senator for Florida – and together, with you never tiring alongside me, I know we can win.**
[**So I need your support, friend. This campaign is a battle of many things, and an unfortunate reality among them is** _resources._**The Republican Party is already proving they will spend whatever it takes to protect Marco Rubio, so if you're with me, if you want to elect Florida's first Black senator and defend our majority in the Senate, please donate $5 or whatever you can before my midnight deadline.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44396848/341401819/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2987-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MjM3MjZiNy1hNWMxLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3I_O7L2pp8TN3T26Avfx8AzF1QpFDU4VvJBJJ7qf-VM=)
Thank you for being in this with me. _Never tire._

Val Demings

body:
Christian Leadership Worldview International | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/bd8d6c0e8fcd/happy-new-year-6072649?e=6582090d83)
---
|
---
**TO: SOUTH CAROLINA REPUBLICANS** Dear Supporters,We are issuing a correction. It has been brought to our attention that an oversight was made on our email distribution posts and we wanted to publicly correct the record.I inadvertently left the name and address of the Christian Leadership Worldview International 501(C)(3) at the bottom of a series of posts for the **LaPierre for House political campaign**. It has since been changed to reflect the correct address and the last several email distribution blasts have also reflected that change.This was done in error as the above nonprofit is being disbanded and has not operated for several years because of the impact of COVID-19. The following is a timeline of the relevant facts.1\. The CLWI website was taken down on September 30th, 2020.2\. Because of the impact of COVID-19, our last day of expenses for Christian Leadership Worldview International was December of 2020. We only had outside donations that year of $169.16.3\. Christian Leadership Worldview had no revenue or expenses in 2021. We are filing our taxes for 2021 in another month and will be sending a notice to the State of South Carolina of our intent to dissolve and shut the 501(C)(3) organization down as a result of COVID-19. It saddens us. 4\. Furthermore, Christian Leadership Worldview has had no revenue or expenses in calendar year 2022.5\. There have been no social media posts from Christian Leadership Worldview on Facebook or Linked-In for the past several years.In effect, we have been waiting for our tax reporting obligation to the State of South Carolina to cycle through so we can shut down the organization.It is with a great deal of regret that I must tell you that a political opponent (a professing Christian) is trying to capitalize on this issue because of a template error. He is trying to politicize this issue by attacking and slandering a soon to be, former religious organization, Christian Leadership Worldview International and its founder, Mike LaPierre, respectively.It appears that there are no lengths that politicians won’t take to smear an opponent. Religious or not. You are probably now wondering why I have the baseball picture at the top of this distribution blast. Well, that photo is actually part of a gospel tract that was created by Pastor John Vaughn. I got saved playing professional baseball and Pastor Vaughn wanted to tell my spiritual life story and asked if he could put it together for me. I WAS HONORED AT THE REQUEST.Unfortunately, it is also with a great deal of regret that I must tell you that a political opponent (a professing Christian) placed this gospel tract on Facebook next to a photo of Joseph Stalin to make a political attack on me inferring that I had an ego on par with Stalin. Pastor Vaughn had written on the bottom of the gospel tract, “What it takes to be #1.” The political opponent (a professing Christian) seized on the opportunity to twist the meaning and intent.Once again, it appears that there are no lengths that politicians won’t take to smear an opponent.It was a pleasure serving as Founder and President of such a wonderful organization all those years. We got to preach and teach leadership principles from the Word of God for many years all around the world. Souls were saved and lives were touched. Please stay tuned for the next chapter that God Almighty has in store for us. God bless you! Mike LaPierre Member, Faith Baptist Church, Taylors, South Carolina
God bless the beautiful state of SOUTH CAROLINA!
|

Peter Willis,
If you’ve been paying attention this year, you know that the rights of transgender people everywhere are under attack. Republican state legislatures have made it their mission to strip transgender people — especially trans youth — of their rights, their identities, and essential services and protections that keep them safe.
**No one should have to face being shut out of society because of how they identify as people.**
We’re fighting back. **Today, we’re rolling out Melanie’s Transgender Rights Policy Agenda.** Here’s Melanie’s solutions-based approach to protecting trans people in this country:
1. **The Equality Act** : In Congress, Melanie will work to whip votes and ensure that the Equality Act finally passes, which would amend the Civil Rights Act of 1964 to prohibit discrimination in all its forms on the basis of gender, gender identity, and/or sexual orientation.

2. **Healthcare** : Melanie would take immediate action to protect Americans from being refused medical care by doctors and/or providers due to their gender identity. The Equality Act, paired with Universal Healthcare, would ensure that no one is denied the medical care they need because of discrimination, coverage or cost, including the gender-affirming care needed to allow everyone to identify as who they are.

3. **Representation** : To fully fund federal resources for LGBTQ+ communities, we have to ensure that these communities are properly represented in government data. To do so, we must update government-created job applications and census questionnaires to reflect gender diversity. LGBTQ+ identities must also be included in the U.S. Census to avoid undercounts that result in underfunding vital LGBTQ+ programs.

4. **Addressing the systemic issues** : To combat hate crimes and discrimination at the local level, we must promote understanding, empathy, and equality towards our LGBTQ+ communities by increasing exposure through education of their history and diversity, funding community-based groups, and making real investments in affordable housing and social services to combat the epidemic of homelessness among LGBTQ+ youth.

This is not a “culture war” issue. This is about protecting the lives of our friends, neighbors, family members, colleagues, and — especially — our children. 40% of trans people have attempted suicide at some point in their lives, about 9 times higher than the national average. Trans youth are especially vulnerable: nearly 2 in 3 trans youth report symptoms of depression.
Democrats cannot stay silent as conservatives seek to take people’s rights away. We have to call out the injustice for what it is and root it out. **Democrats shouldn't be afraid of doing what's right — that's what we run on and are elected to do.**
That’s why Melanie is running for Congress. As a working mom, health care advocate, and organizer, she knows that it takes one of us to fight for all of us. An attack on LGBTQ+ rights is an attack on all of our rights — and Melanie is not afraid to fight back.
**[You can find more information about Melanie’s Transgender Rights Policy Agenda here.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/CMxF4nARlf6wAFa1PSfv0jKbyWoioh0jZmB3VOLK2i35Lf0Aa1EmtnmFYmW9hP_Z2JUzly7IFfS6Y5b1xP6db3-A_Rmq5tydlgqzQxPk7A7Fqud7wcNxEcfeyxxKnkma-fe7sEopi_J4-xJH4L2uZ24WeLnCcumAYK_6gmCV7w48blgMOj_3yOb8KKWXT-xwWvuLYX8RV9AQs8dAwkA-LB2o-dZrtjjP-3UKdcPvVxe3KlOFPVAqRS7L4sDLbo83d4vlX3N0ZApLK2LKUMW1kvm-AWZyYpS01PS0p-iKBkQ/3le/a5Jp67QPSmemkeF5wfi6xQ/h1/ZBo-4gwx4SmgzrCwVdmfVGPDcAtMyoDXM4v_u-sNf08)**
Thanks for standing with us to fight for trans people.
Team Melanie

A new low, friend – Republicans are reacting to our fair redistricting victories by **attempting to UNDERMINE the independent power of the judicial branch.**
“Democrats have fared much better than expected in the ongoing redistricting cycle... Their success has supercharged a two-pronged effort by Republicans to change the way judges are selected to the bench at the state level while **seeking to erode the power of state courts at the federal level.”** – Business Insider
Here’s some of what the GOP is doing:
1) They’re promoting “independent state legislature” theory, a fringe legal argument that state legislatures should have sole power over congressional elections.

2) They’re attempting to stack state supreme courts with their hand-picked judges.

3) And they’re even threatening to impeach justices who have voted against them, which is **“incredibly dangerous”** according to experts!
This is a _multi-state, multi-year_ effort. But we don't have to take it lying down. Here's what the NDRC is doing to **fight back:**
→ Helping to elect Democrats in 2022.
→ Holding politicians who attack fair-minded judges accountable.
→ Supporting reforms that take redistricting out of the hands of partisan lawmakers.
→ Staying vigilant and reacting quickly to underhanded schemes to erode our system of checks and balances.

The Cuyahoga River caught fire at least 11 times before June 22, 1969, but that was the day it finally made national news.

Cleveland mayor Carl Stokes brought global attention to the 1969 disaster, and his demands for federal action helped spur the growth of the environmental movement.

With renewed momentum, Wisconsin's Senator Gaylord Nelson organized the first Earth Day less than a year later, and Congress passed the bipartisan Clean Water Act and Clean Air Act, created the Environmental Protection Act, and enacted many more environmental protections in the years to come.

But in recent years, dark money groups and corporate interests have gradually erased many of the protections we've won over the last 53 years and blocked our ability to address climate change.

Just as in 1969, solving the crisis we face in 2022 is a project bigger than any one person, city, state, or nation. Congress must enact laws that help us address these targets now.

We were traveling on a Paris-bound train when a terrorist emerged from the bathroom, bare-chested and armed with an assault rifle, a jar of gasoline, and 270 rounds of ammunition attempted to take over and kill us all. Now, our homeland is in danger. Not from radical Islamic terrorists, but radical Democrats who want to fundamentally alter the fabric of this GREAT nation. Leftist legislation is assaulting our Nation, our communities, and the American Dream. Right now, Democrats are... Opening and destroying our borders. Defunding the police, leading to a surge in violent crime Erasing historical figures from our schools like George Washington and Abraham Lincoln Teetering on the edge of a dangerous foreign policy crisis These power-hungry Democrat elitists like Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden don’t care about the people they represent. The only way to pull America out of this leftist tailspin is by taking back the House in 2022. We need a fighter in Congress, Fellow Conservative and I hope that hearing my story proves to you that I am the man for the job.** My life’s mission has always been to represent the America I know and love - the world’s bastion of freedom and economic prosperity. Dear Peter,
Our people-powered movement continues to gain momentum. I’m delighted to receive the endorsement of Greenbelt City Councilman Ric Gordon! As one of Prince George’s County's leading champions, Ric has proudly served our communities in more ways than one. He’s a community activist, an advocate for neighbors, a practicing political scientist, and a consummate public servant. He’s fought to empower residents through voter registration drives and has rallied against community violence. It is a distinct honor to have received his endorsement.
Ric, thank you for your support from the bottom of my heart. As Maryland’s next Governor, I’ll proudly work with you to deliver the bold solutions and concrete results that Marylanders need now more than ever.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ricgordonendorsement?amount=20.22 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ricgordonendorsement?amount=20.22]
This latest endorsement is yet another indication of the growing strength of our inclusive, statewide coalition of support. I’ve already received endorsements from over 100 current and former elected officials from all corners of Maryland. And recent polls show that our team has a strong lead over the rest of the field. With your help, we can pull ahead even further in the final stretch of this competitive primary race.
Will you power our movement to victory by helping us meet our fundraising goal of $2,175 by 11:59 PM tonight? By chipping in, you’ll help us print more yard signs and field literature, create more T-shirts and bumper stickers, run more ads, knock on more doors, place more phone calls, and ultimately secure the votes we need to win on July 19.

If I’m blessed to be Maryland’s next Governor, I’ll deliver on the concrete points of progress to lift our communities into the high quality of life that they deserve. From combating the student debt crisis, to lowering the costs of healthcare, to making Maryland the first carbon neutral state in the nation, to leveling the playing field for Black Marylanders, we have a truly exciting opportunity to redefine the promise and possibility of state government.
Our team is leading out in front – and we couldn’t do it without your help. Any amount, whether large or small, will go a long way towards securing a stronger future for Maryland in the years to come.
Thank you for your continued support for our people-powered movement.

### Tim Aalders Releases Second TV Ad
#### John Curtis is focused on Wall Street day trading for his personal retirement account when he should be looking out for Main Street voters back in Utah

_Highland, UT –_ Conservative Republican Tim Aalders, candidate for Congress in Utah’s Third Congressional District, released his second TV ad this week. The 30 second commercial reveals that incumbent Congressman John Curtis spends more time working on his day trading on Wall Street rather than focusing on Main Street back in Utah. The ad appears on Fox News spread out among four Salt Lake City area cable networks, as well as on streaming platforms across the Third Congressional District.

Aalders stated, **“Last year John Curtis made 348 trades of individual stocks including pandemic stocks like Zoom and manufacturers of medical devices during COVID, and later he held stocks in Raytheon and other defense companies while Congress was debating sending military weapons to Ukraine. He refuses to stop what everyone knows should end – padding his retirement account by actively participating in day trading with private information gained as a member of Congress.” **

Aalders continued, **“Even the casual viewer recognizes this unethical behavior, and Curtis building of a new 10,000 square foot mansion is just a symbol of what is wrong with Washington DC. There is even a meme out there showing that he is the #4 top trader in the House – beating Nancy Pelosi’s returns.” **

Regarding Congress forcing Curtis to end this behavior Aalders said, **“The House Ethics Committee has long recommended that members of Congress have all of their investments in blind trusts, and many ethics professionals have recommended that members of Congress at the very least not trade individual stocks but rather have investments in mutual funds to avoid the appearance of a conflict of interest. There are bipartisan bills that would no longer allow members of Congress to use their inside knowledge in the trading of individual stocks. But John Curtis cares more about making money on Wall Street rather than being a Congressman representing Main Street in Utah.”**

This November, the American people will have a choice: vote in favor of upholding our democracy, or vote in favor of the GOP extremists working to undermine it - extremists like Sen. Josh Hawley.
My friend, Sen. Brian Schatz, recently made news for calling out Sen. Hawley's indefensible efforts to hold up President Biden's civilian nominees to the Department of Defense and to the Department of State - positions which are critical to our national security. A particularly absurd suggestion from Sen. Hawley was that the president's support for Ukraine was wavering.
Make no mistake: President Biden has been a central leader in organizing global support for Ukraine, and he just announced an additional $800 million in weapons, ammunition, and other security assistance to aid their defense. His support for Ukraine in their fight for freedom has been outstanding.
What has Hawley done? The contrast couldn't be more clear: He voted "no" on Ukraine aid and then attempted to pin the blame on this administration for moving too slowly to help our Ukrainian allies. Does he think we are not smart enough to notice his hypocrisy?
But this is just scratching the surface of his heinous record.
When Donald Trump was first impeached for withholding aid to Ukraine in order to pressure President Zelenskyy into doing him a political favor, Hawley voted to acquit him. When Trump incited a deadly insurrection to overturn the results of the 2020 election, Hawley raised his fist to show his support for the mob. And during Judge Ketanji Brown Jackson's historic Senate confirmation hearings, Hawley gave voice to far-right conspiracy theorists' baseless, despicable smears against her.
Sen. Schatz said it best: "Spare me the new solidarity with the Ukrainians and with the free world - because this man's record is exactly the opposite."
And yet, Josh Hawley is a leader in today's Republican Party - a party that is just one seat away from gaining control of the Senate. We cannot let the Senate fall to right-wing extremists. We cannot allow them the chance to dismantle our democracy and resume where they left off in their dangerous agenda - because that's exactly what they'll do if they retake the majority this November.
**[With Senate Republicans setting fundraising records, I'm asking you today to fight back: Will you donate $5 or more right now to defend the Senate for Democrats? The GOP only needs to flip one seat to take back control of the entire Senate, and I need every bit of grassroots support to protect my seat against my GOP challengers.](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1170-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)**
What happens in November will be a pivotal moment for our country and for our institutions. Thank you for stepping up today to help make sure democracy prevails.
Dick
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com.

Peter,

I have to admit - I hadn't heard of the far-left publication called _The Nation_ before last week. Now, I'll never forget it.

They published an attack piece against me - based on the color of my skin - that is beyond ridiculous and insulting.

While I'm personally very offended, I'm genuinely sad for the author of this political hit piece.

There are a lot of nasty things said about me in this article simply because I'm a Black Republican. Like this:

name: Tom Fitton
subject: We work hard every day through the legal system…and as you can tell, we deliver real results!
body:
Judicial Watch just announced a major victory for cleaner elections! We settled our federal lawsuit against North Carolina after the state removed over 430,000 ineligible names from its voter rolls!

| |
---
|
---
|
---
| Dear Fellow American,

Great news...Judicial Watch is on a roll!
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=58687&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=)
---

On March 25th, a Maryland court ruled in favor of Judicial Watch's challenge to Maryland's congressional redistricting plan. In its ruling the court _permanently barred_ the "extreme" plan created by the Democratic-controlled Maryland legislature.

Judicial Watch filed the lawsuit on behalf of 12 registered Maryland voters who object to Maryland's 2021 congressional redistricting plan on the grounds that it is a partisan gerrymander that diminishes their rights to participate in free, fair elections for the U.S. Congress on an equal basis with other Maryland voters, in violation of the Maryland Constitution.

The court agreed and threw out the plan. In response, the Maryland legislature passed and the Maryland governor signed into law a new, more reasonable plan that better respects the rights of ALL voters.

This key Judicial Watch court victory against abusive partisan gerrymandering in Maryland could set a national precedent!

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=58687&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=)
---

And just one week later, on April 1st, a California court ruled unconstitutional the state's racial, ethnic, and LGBT quota for corporate boards of directors. The court granted Judicial Watch's motion for _summary judgment_ in its taxpayer lawsuit asking the court to declare the quota scheme unconstitutional under California's constitution.

The lawsuit was filed by Judicial Watch on behalf of three California taxpayers to prevent California from enforcing Assembly Bill 979. The bill requires that boards of directors of California-based, publicly held domestic or foreign corporations satisfy a racial, ethnic and LGBT quota.

This historic California court decision declared _unconstitutional_ one of the most blatant attacks in the modern era on constitutional prohibitions against discrimination. In its ruling, the court upheld the core American value of _equal protection under the law_.

At Judicial Watch, we work hard every day through the legal system...and as you can tell, we deliver real results!

We are tenacious, and we dig in for the long haul. To do that, [we rely on our members and supporters. Will you join with us by making a special tax-deductible gift today?](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=58687&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=)

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=58687&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=)
---

None of what we accomplish fighting for the rule of law and constitutional principles would be possible without the support we receive from patriotic Americans.

Please join with us today!

Sincerely,

Tom Fitton
President

We made a lot of promises in the 2020 election. Promises to make our democracy and our economy work for everyone. But Democrats haven’t delivered on all of those promises yet, and we’re running out of time. If Congress fails to deliver, we’re going to face big losses in November, and we’ll lose more than our majorities — we’ll lose our ability to get things done for working people. But there’s still time to act. I wrote an op-ed for the _New York Times_ about what Democrats need to do right now. I’m sharing it below — **give it a read, reply to this email with your thoughts, and keep up the fight to make meaningful change for families across the country.** Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth
* * *
**OPINION** **GUEST ESSAY** **Elizabeth Warren: Democrats Can Avoid Disaster in November** Democrats are the party of working people. Ahead of the 2020 election, we advanced ideas and plans that we believed would, in ways big and small, make our democracy and our economy work better for all Americans. Across this country, voters agreed with us — and gave us a majority in Washington so that we could deliver on those promises. Republican senators and broken institutions have blocked much of that promised progress. Now Republicans are betting that a stalled Biden agenda won’t give Democrats enough to run on in the midterm elections — and they might be right. Despite pandemic relief, infrastructure investments and the historic Supreme Court confirmation of Ketanji Brown Jackson, we promised more — and voters remember those promises. Republicans want to frame the upcoming elections to be about “wokeness,” cancel culture and the “militant left wing.” Standing up for the inherent dignity of everyone is a core American value, and Democrats are proud to do that every day. While Republican politicians peddle lies, fear and division, we should use every single one of the next 200 days or so before the election to deliver meaningful improvements for working people. Democrats win elections when we show we understand the painful economic realities facing American families and convince voters we will deliver meaningful change. To put it bluntly: if we fail to use the months remaining before the elections to deliver on more of our agenda, Democrats are headed toward big losses in the midterms. Time is running short. We need to finalize a budget reconciliation deal, making giant corporations pay their share to fund vital investments in combating climate change and lowering costs for families, which can advance with only 50 Senate votes. Other priorities can be done with the president’s executive authority. It’s no secret that I believe we should abolish the filibuster. But if Republicans want to use it to block policies that Americans broadly support, we should also force them to take those votes in plain view. Let’s begin with corruption. For years, Americans have identified corrupt government officials as a top concern. And they’re right: to tackle the urgent challenges we face — climate change, income inequality, systemic injustice — we must root out corruption. To start cleaning up government, members of Congress and their spouses shouldn’t be allowed to own or trade individual stocks, which the vast majority of voters support banning, according to multiple polls. Whether you’re a Republican senator or the Democratic speaker of the House, it is obvious to the American people that they should not be allowed to trade individual stocks and then vote on laws that affect those companies. I have the strongest plan and the only bipartisan bill in the Senate to get it done. We can also act quickly to rein in costs for middle-class families. In the very short term, that means stopping companies from jacking up prices to boost their profits. Price increases are driven by many factors, including pandemic disruptions to global supply chains and Vladimir Putin’s war in Ukraine. But when the Kroger chief executive, Rodney McMullen, said “a little bit of inflation is always good in our business,” it’s no surprise that, by a margin of two-to-one, American voters don’t buy the explanation that companies are just passing along costs. Instead, they blame corporations for raising prices to boost their own profits. Even Fed Chair Jerome Powell, a conservative Republican, acknowledged that giant corporations raise prices simply “because they can.” The president deserves enormous credit for advancing an ambitious agenda to promote competition and appointing effective regulators to enforce our antitrust laws, and it’s time for congressional Democrats to have his back. According to Data for Progress surveys, eight in 10 Americans believe Congress should pass laws to reinvigorate competition and three-quarters strongly believe that oil and gas companies should not make gobs of money off this energy crisis. Beefing up regulators’ authority to end price-gouging, breaking up monopolies, and passing a windfall profits tax is a good start. Only in Washington, where America’s biggest companies spend billions to drown out reality, are these controversial ideas. Across America, these are popular plans. We can stand up to the armies of lobbyists and P.R. flacks and tackle tax loopholes for the rich and powerful. About two-thirds of likely American voters — including a majority of Republicans — say it’s time for billionaires to pay more in taxes. Nearly three-quarters of Americans want to put an end to wildly profitable corporations paying nothing or little in federal income taxes (yes, Amazon, I’m looking at you) and put into place a global minimum corporate tax. And a majority of Americans would like to use some of those tax revenues to invest in clean energy, affordable child care, and universal pre-K. That’s a big legislative agenda, but it isn’t big enough. We also need to use every tool of the presidency to deliver for working people. For example, by a margin of more than two-to-one, Americans support providing some student loan debt cancellation — an action the president could take entirely on his own. Doing so would lift the economic outlook for too many borrowers who still weren’t able to get a college diploma, for the millions of female borrowers who shoulder about two-thirds of all student loan debt, and for Black and Hispanic borrowers, a higher percentage of whom take on debt to attend college compared to white students, and have a harder time paying it off after school. With the stroke of a pen, the president could make massive strides to close gender and racial wealth gaps. And he can do more. Decisive action on everything from lowering prescription drug prices to ensuring that more workers are eligible for overtime pay can be executed by the president alone, using the authority already given to him by existing laws, without rounding up 50 Senate votes. Like many Americans, I’m frustrated by our failure to get big things done — things that are both badly needed and very popular with all Americans. While Republican politicians obstruct many efforts to improve people’s lives and many swear loyalty to the Big Lie, the urgency of the next election bears down on us. Democrats cannot bow to the wisdom of out-of-touch consultants who recommend we simply tout our accomplishments. Instead, Democrats need to deliver more of the president’s agenda — or else we will not be in the majority much longer.
* * *

name: Greg Stamps
subject: The history of capitalism and socialism
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWTELMUHNj

Over the last century, free-market capitalism and socialism have
provided the dominant interpretations, and conflicting visions,
of political and econ
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWTELMUHNj

Dear
Friend,

Over the
last century, free-market capitalism and socialism have provided
the dominant interpretations, and conflicting visions, of
political and economic freedom. In the past few years, we've seen
a growing trend among young Americans in favor of socialism and
against capitalism.

But do
they truly understand the history and outcomes of socialism and
capitalism?

This is
precisely why we put together this brand new eBook, The History
Of Socialism And Capitalism, from Hoover Institution senior
fellows Niall Ferguson and Victor Davis Hanson.

This
eBook consists of two papers-one from each scholar-written in
conjunction with The Human Prosperity Project on Socialism and
Free-Market Capitalism. This project provides objective and
scholarly analyses of free-market capitalism, socialism, and
hybrid systems and provides evidence on the effectiveness of the
various systems on outcomes that affect prosperity and
well-being.

I think
you will find this new eBook particularly important and timely,
given the recent interest in policies that are radical from a US
historical perspective, some of which are advocated by political
leaders.

Simply
click here to request your free copy of The History Of Socialism
And Capitalism.

Thanks,
Greg

Greg
Stamps | Online Development
Hoover
Institution | Stanford University

With its
eminent scholars and world-renowned Library and Archives, the
Hoover Institution is a non-partisan, data-driven policy research
organization that seeks to improve the human condition by
advancing ideas that promote economic prosperity, national
security, and democratic governance. Over more than one hundred
years, Hoover's work has directly led to policies that have
produced greater freedom, democracy, and opportunity in the
United States and around the world.

Fellow Conservative,

Like so many Americans, I watched the scenes of Afghanistan's fall with disbelief, extreme sadness and even anger. You see, I served the greatest country on Earth in Afghanistan back in 2015. But Afghanistan wasn't the only place I looked terrorism directly in the eyes...

**August 21 st 2021 marked six years since the fateful late-summer afternoon that changed my life and those of my two best friends - forever.**

**I had just finished serving our great nation in Afghanistan when my best friends and I decided to take a vacation in Europe**. We were traveling on a Paris-bound train when a terrorist emerged from the bathroom, bare-chested and armed with an assault rifle, a jar of gasoline, and 270 rounds of ammunition attempted to take over and kill us all.

As a soldier, I was trained to take out a terrorist threat -As an American, I was taught to stand up for freedom no matter where I was in the world. **Which is why I, my friends and other brave travelers took the action needed to stop this terrorist.**

This split-second decision prevented what witnesses contend could have become a mass slaughter. There is a reason I was able to make this split-second decision to intervene, Fellow Conservative - **I have and always will be willing to give my life in the fight for freedom, in the image of true American values.**

[**At the end of this email, I am going to ask you to donate $3 to my campaign for Congress, in honor of the sixth anniversary of the Thalys train attack. Right now, Democrats are...
* Opening and destroying our borders. They are g**ranting dangerous amnesty** that will flood every corner of America.
* **Raising our taxes** like we have never seen, and making common goods like gas and groceries unaffordable.
* **Defunding the police,** leading to a surge in violent crime
* **Erasing historical figures** from our schools like George Washington and Abraham Lincoln
* Teetering on the edge of a **dangerous foreign policy crisis**

These power-hungry Democrat elitists like Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden don’t care about the people they represent. **They only care about their own radical agenda.**

**This is just not okay, folks:** High school students had plans to put on the musical _Rent: School Edition_ — a musical about young artists living in New York City during the AIDS epidemic. But the school administration denied their proposal for being too “controversial,” according to Central Bucks West’s drama club members. Students are speaking out against the decision because the musical depicts LGBTQ relationships, and the students believe this initial denial is related to the wave of conservative laws banning LGBTQ+ books in schools across the country. One of the most banned books that the right-wing tries to censor is Toni Morrison’s _The Bluest Eye_ — a book Ashley proudly owns a well-worn copy of on her bookshelf at home. **[Ashley believes every student deserves an education that celebrates inclusivity, justice, and civil rights. name: JusticeDemocrats.com
subject: After AOC defeated the 4th most powerful Democrat in the House:
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

The Democratic establishment was reeling after AOC defeated the 4th most
powerful Democrat in the House. The Democratic Congressional Campaign
Committee (DCCC) was scrambling so much to stop progressives that it
created a Blacklist.

What was the DCCC blacklist? It started in early 2019 and it blacklisted
any vendors, staffers, and organizations that supported primary
challengers to Democratic incumbents — officially putting the interests of
a handful of corporate-backed, conservative Democrats above the will of
Democratic voters.

Why did the DCCC do it? House leadership was afraid more Justice Democrats
like AOC and Ayanna Pressley would defeat long-time incumbents. They were
afraid of the Squad growing. They were afraid of a stronger challenge to
the corporate-backed establishment in Congress.

The DCCC was trying to block working-class progressives from a slew of
critical campaign resources. But Justice Democrats were ready to meet the
challenge of this anti-democratic policy.

Two of our recruits, Cori Bush and Jamaal Bowman, still defeated long-time
corporate incumbents in 2020 while the DCCC Blacklist was in effect. We
were not afraid of the Democratic establishment and we continue to win
races despite the odds stacked against us.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/103900?refcode=em20220421-22971&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=22971%2E1203867%2EmyEhfJ ]In order to continue winning races against the deep-pocketed
corporate-backed Democratic establishment, we need the help of our
grassroots supporters. Peter,
can you chip in $3 to help
us run strong campaigns and elect more Justice Democrats?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/103900?refcode=em20220421-22971&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=22971%2E1203867%2EmyEhfJ ]Contribute

The DCCC announced an end to the blacklist after the 2020 elections — it
was more of a PR nightmare for them than an effective tool against
progressive primaries.

But we’re not surprised House Speaker Nancy Pelosi continues to support
conservative anti-abortion Democrat Henry Cuellar against Justice Democrat
Jessica Cisneros. Pelosi said, “I support my incumbents. I support every
one of them.”

Justice Democrats started because we can’t just elect Democrats, we have
to elect BETTER Democrats — progressive fighters like AOC, Ayanna, Cori,
Jamaal and others who support Medicare for All and a Green New Deal.

Pelosi’s choice in TX-28, Cuellar, voted against abortion rights, labor
rights, AND worked to block Build Back Better, all in the last year. Those
are huge parts of the Democratic agenda. But Pelosi is still backing
Cuellar.

While we fight for economic, social, racial, and environmental justice,
corporate Democrats like Cuellar and many others will try to protect
corporate profits and the status quo.

We don’t take a cent from corporate PACs. Meanwhile, corporate Democrats
take money from Wall Street, Big Oil, Big Pharma, payday loan companies,
and union-busters. It’s clear: Justice Democrats will fight for the
people, the Democratic establishment will work for their corporate donors.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/103900?refcode=em20220421-22971&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=22971%2E1203867%2EmyEhfJ ]Peter,
will you donate today to help us win our
primaries against the Democratic establishment and its Wall Street-backed
candidates? Together, we can overcome the odds and grow the Squad in
Congress.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/103900?refcode=em20220421-22971&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=22971%2E1203867%2EmyEhfJ ]Contribute

Thank you for all that you do to support our work and our primary
candidates.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1024&akid=22971%2E1203867%2EmyEhfJ ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1025&akid=22971%2E1203867%2EmyEhfJ ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20220421-22971-footer&t=1026&refcode2=22971_1203867_myEhfJ&akid=22971%2E1203867%2EmyEhfJ

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
The facts are, canceling student debt is racial justice, economic justice, and gender justice.
#
Peter, earlier this week, Pramila tweeted something very clear about student debt cancellation.
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/12411?refcode=em20220421-1201&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=1201%2E420207%2EcKoNdv)
Then, Fox & Friends railed against it. It’s unfortunately so typical that Fox News would get upset at a leader like Pramila for fighting for social, racial, economic, gender, and environmental justice.
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/12411?refcode=em20220421-1201&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=1201%2E420207%2EcKoNdv)
This will not deter Pramila, Peter. But we’re not only up against the lawmakers who oppose canceling student debt, we’re also up against cable news shows who would rather target Pramila than provide the facts about student loan debt.
[**We know Pramila is fighting for a policy that will help more than 45 million people in this country. If you’re with us in the fight to cancel student loan debt, please chip in $3 to support Pramila’s advocacy.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/12411?refcode=em20220421-1201&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=1201%2E420207%2EcKoNdv)
**[Contribute $3 »](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/12411?refcode=em20220421-1201&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=1201%2E420207%2EcKoNdv)**
We know the facts: Women hold two-thirds of student debt, and Black borrowers owe $25,000 more on average than white borrowers. Erasing federal student loan debt would get rid of these disparities and relieve the burden of debt for more than 45 million people.
That’s racial justice. That’s gender justice. That’s economic justice.
No matter what Fox News says, this is the reality in America. And we can do something about it.
[**If you can, contribute today and help Pramila fight for student debt cancellation, even as she faces unfair attacks from Fox News.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/12411?refcode=em20220421-1201&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&akid=1201%2E420207%2EcKoNdv)
In solidarity,
Team Jayapal

body:
There are only 24 women in the Senate — and zero Black women.
#

Judge Ketanji Brown Jackson’s confirmation earlier this month was a thrilling and historic moment.
But this New York Times headline was a stark reminder of the reality of the U.S. Senate today:
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-apr22?refcode=em220421-1-t1&refcode2=750.357359.BxjPCu&t=1&akid=750%2E357359%2EBxjPCu)
[**We can change that in November. Pitch in $3 today to help us elect Cheri Beasley as North Carolina’s first Black senator and only the third Black woman ever elected to the Senate. It is going to take all of us to pull off this historic victory.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-apr22?refcode=em220421-1-t1&refcode2=750.357359.BxjPCu&t=2&akid=750%2E357359%2EBxjPCu)
Diversity is often touted as one of our nation’s greatest strengths, but as it stands today, the United States Senate does not reflect the diversity of our nation.
There are only 24 women in the Senate — and zero Black women.
But we know we get better policy outcomes when the people writing our laws understand the challenges facing our families and reflect the diversity of America. It also changes the future all of our children can envision for themselves — teaching them to dream bigger.
That’s the impact we can have when we flip this seat in November. We can make sure Black women have a vote on the next Supreme Court nomination — and ensure Mitch McConnell isn’t allowed to obstruct President Biden’s nominees.

| | **NEWS RELEASE**

**Gubernatorial candidate Kerry McQuisten says Oregon election corruption blatant in recent candidates poll**

Baker City, OR—April 21, 2022—Today, Florida-based Jeff Reynolds of PJ Media broke a story from Oregon regarding a shocking example of voter manipulation. Link HERE: [Will The 2022 Red Wave Hit Oregon? – PJ Media](https://KerryMcQuisten.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8a6f5300a53ab781de615e5a1&id=4bf259895f&e=ae2345792a)

In coordination with that coverage and resulting interview requests, Republican gubernatorial candidate Kerry McQuisten issued the following statement:

“Hello, everyone. As a grassroots candidate, I had a front row view of Oregon’s establishment swamp on full display last week, and I intend to fight it tooth and nail.

“Here’s what happened. Candidates were notified recently that Oregon media would host a televised Republican gubernatorial candidates debate on April 21. Participation in this event would provide a huge bump to qualifying candidates, and was a critical step in this election. Seven criteria were listed in order to make the TV debate. I immediately met the first six.

“The seventh, a score of five-percent or higher in a scientific poll, seemed like a slam dunk based on the traction of my campaign and past polling. I was shocked to receive notice that I had scored abysmally low on a poll and would not be allowed on television. The more I looked at the results of all the campaigns, the more disbelief I felt, as nearly none of them reflected what I was seeing boots-on-the-ground or when compared to other polling. In fact, only one candidate seemed to benefit from the poll, and that candidate was Christine Drazan whose popularity had jumped remarkably.

“Was this jump the result of TV ads alone? Or was it something more?

“I didn’t want to be one of those candidates who whines when things seem unfair, or who points fingers at my competition. I didn’t want to rail against the left-leaning media as I know that could just look like sour grapes, frankly, and speaking out might harm my own campaign.

“But I took a look at the poll. It was conducted in one afternoon, which is odd for any poll. Voters across the state commented that they had received calls days earlier and were asked questions similar or identical to those on that poll. Could those who were called have been pre-screened for their responses? Perhaps we’ll never know.

“I then looked at the margin of error. 4.3%. Statistically speaking, nearly every candidate fell within that margin of error, making the poll unusable, but yet it was used. A minimum poll sample of 520 individuals was also used. 68% said they were undecided and didn’t make a selection, meaning around 167 individuals made up the entire response. On that number alone, again, the poll should have been tossed; it still wasn’t.

“Strangely, a Constitution Party candidate was included into the middle of the strictly Republican poll. Why? This candidate would not even be on the primary ballot. This was the third reason in a row that this poll should have been considered null and void.

“Instead, Bud Pierce and Christine Drazan were allowed into the televised debate based on this deeply flawed data, an outcome set to affect the entire primary election. Two candidates out of 18 wouldn’t have been much of a debate, so a ‘leaning toward’ number was randomly factored in, allowing two other male candidates, but arguably not Ms. Drazan’s strongest competitors to date, into the debate.

“I decided to look even deeper into the poll, and this is when it became clear that speaking out or not speaking out was no longer a matter of campaign strategy. This was a matter of right and wrong, and I had to do what my conscience knew was right and let the chips fall.

“I found that J.L. Wilson’s firm, Nelson Research out of Salem had been tapped to perform the poll. According to a Willamette Week article, Wilson’s other firm, Public Affairs Counsel, covered the cost.

“Upon closer scrutiny, I discovered that J. L. Wilson has financial ties to one current Republican gubernatorial candidate, and only one: Christine Drazan.

“See, Wilson is also a registered lobbyist with the State of Oregon for nearly 50 different organizations and companies ranging from Oregon Wild to 7-Eleven. As we know, Ms. Drazan came into this race quickly and substantially funded through lobbyist connections. More specifically, over her two years in the legislature and into this campaign, her PAC, Friends of Christine Drazan, received hundreds of thousands of dollars both directly and indirectly through J. L. Wilson’s clients.

“What we have here is one of the most shockingly corrupt, inappropriate cases of election manipulation in recent memory. We have a television station contracting with a polling firm whose lobbyist owner has a vested interest in seeing one specific candidate make it through the primary. This goes beyond a conflict of interest.

“Oregonians, we have a huge election integrity issue out in the open right now, and we have the chance to stop it before the ballots even drop. I believe this situation needs investigated for criminal wrongdoing. I believe if Christine Drazan gets through the primary, or if any deep state establishment-selected milquetoast moderate does for that matter, we will lose the general election as Oregon Republicans always do. The honest, salt-of-the-earth conservative base will once again sit on their ballots. These lobbyists and their benefactors don’t care about saving our state. They are power brokers, catering to the left just as frequently as to the right. This level of corruption on my own side of the aisle contributes in large part to why Oregon’s good, honest Republicans lose races and why Oregon stays blue. If you, voters, allow this to go by unchecked, Republicans will once again steal defeat from the jaws of victory. I’m here to do everything I can to stop that from happening.

”I’m a ranch kid from northeast Oregon. I’m a small city mayor. I’m a business owner not a politician. I’m also one of you and I’m trying to save my state. It is high time we drain the Oregon swamp, and it starts now because this election is our last chance. Thank you for listening.”
# # #

I am so pleased to announce that I have been given a 100% Rating from Pro-Life Wisconsin. I will continue to fight for the unborn. I will continue the fight to end the cruel and unconstitutional practice of abortion.

It has recently come to my campaign's attention that in California there is a bill before the state legislature, [SB2223](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001U0Nfvxl97oVzpjzpVASO5zJiuot5aMPUG6iX7vcz5e71LTkJJCHKj9pjbBVtnqfBGYfK4uOXoC42SeuR8T-ttd9QMmwyCJ75T4rJBJBn4nkgIkaGeI13KeuzTuI6pG9gOkCQS6qRVdVUBQVEuVIz5EJD9P95EUqUlSVEMi-IkvgWEZdNyo6YPCALQJgFrH5FWjMkdzTps_aVWso9TCEan1lJbg3_RjhQy72T8d575XU=&c=a_WIwP3w7eNGFAnCuN5orDesk4pSs-ZpyW3xAOP14G29OxCuGAI2jg==&ch=O1bVg9fqh0U83G78k4R_KNd3oQm5IJ2fiWgP98ZLYGfGEoBfvF8Cmg==), that would allow for "abortion" up to 28 days after the child is born. While this bill has not passed beyond committee, it is shocking that this would even be considered a legal remedy for anyone. This is MURDER!!! There is no other word for it.

Mark Pocan loves to cite science as his justification for his support of abortion on demand. What Mark Pocan does not understand is, the science. Over 95% of biologists have affirmed that human life begins at conception. One such biologist states, "Human development begins after the union of male and female gametes or germ cells during a process known as fertilization (conception)..." Moore, Keith L. Essentials of Human Embryology. Toronto: B.C. Decker Inc, 1988, p.2.

|
### The science on abortion has been clear for decades. It is time we end the horrific practice of abortion once and for all. Abortion is not healthcare. Abortion is not a Constitutional Right. It is murder, plain and simple. I cannot wait to be on the right side of history and vote for legislation that ends abortion nationwide.

Charity Barry

body:
I just spoke to my treasurer, and I have some huge news. We got our fundraising numbers in, and you're going to want to see this. I have literally spent my entire career preparing to lead at this moment, and I'm so | Dear friends, I had to stop for a minute to write you this thank you note. I just spoke to my treasurer, and I have some huge news. **We can now report we have collected over $2 MILLION DOLLARS since the start of this campaign.** **And we have over $1 MILLION in the bank right now.** We could not have done this without your help. It's a huge accomplishment, _but we are not done yet._ Help us keep up this momentum as we raise the next million. **[If you donate now, it will help us get a head start on our next critical fundraising deadline.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zJ7b5wNyzKPLhTo-AgqfOTj9hmS-8LvnA8qY7ch-Dzug6dl9gPuRMb3bOhVFFcRLw0UGIYDRXXAk5w3L8jSEYZXD6f-WoRxyUEEt6PFDD2Fse296kW9HNNQHJLbakggYuIoNpUUPRt2S7lCDIXPMMDgWm6oOGz4wSMc4rZicUHd13kmkaJ4VlxVlQVyy4_2XLNathAHsc3PC2T3UlludWWp2hOfZA7NtjEjS5QDKam2R26jLYpgc8HQNXMZSjfwY9ABMTDUBxDMxvEZ3x6m4PCgBKH6UJnk-C-C2bpr7N5L3C-krz7eglgxSL2WnWCNk_cWUf8RDnQGqt7EVxiXwm8W-HMrnHjlvjH3KVe51BLopOHbwUPLPdCYWnm-GzDRMA/3le/nB9Dw3VYRNOOmAg5yx8VuA/h0/QoixA2xygpPHaStYRCJgfrxMGy5wt-yTTiFMBlI4oK0)**
---
_I spend a lot of time raising money._ **That 's time I'd much rather spend out talking to voters about how we're going to make Maryland safe. **We have to tackle crime, which is the #1 issue facing Maryland this election. | | | Fellow Conservative,

This is a longer email than usual but for the past months, I have become the #1 target of the Left, the liberal biased media, and Big Tech giants like Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube.

I have been smeared again and again by media companies like The New York Times, Washington Post, and the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel where they distort my comments, twist them through a liberal prism, and omit most of what I actually say.

I have been silenced, censored, and suspended by the social media oligarchs because I tell the truth, and oftentimes, it is the truth the liberal mainstream media does not want to hear. It counters their narrative, and they refuse to allow it. So they silence free speech.

Yet, despite all of this unconstitutional collusion between these far-Left parties working for political gain at the expense of the American people, I will not give up. They will not deter me.
And that is why I decided to run for re-election.

I am running for a third term for the simple reason that I believe I am the best person for the job. I believe that I am the best candidate to address the national debt, work to lower inflation, secure the border, and fight for America First policies. I believe I am the best candidate to put an end to the Biden administration's constant record of misinformation and their continued lack of transparency with Congress, the press, and you, Fellow Conservative. I believe I am the best candidate for Wisconsin because I tell the truth and speak for the minority, even when the majority is doing everything they can to silence me.

Now that I have announced, the Left will seize every opportunity to destroy me politically. They will continue to write manipulative hit pieces and orchestrate smear campaigns across all mediums. They will attack and distort my record of success, my record of searching for the truth, and my record of fighting for the people of Wisconsin in any way they can. And that's why I need your help.

| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/10042?t=6&akid=1896%2E878179%2EjjT12b) Friend --

Mike Pence's PAC recently announced a $10 million ad buy against me and other vulnerable Democrats across the country. The ad was rated as false by the Washington Post, but with that kind of money behind it in a newly drawn district, it's sure to have an effect on folks who aren't as familiar with me.

I'm disappointed that Mike Pence is getting involved in our race, but frankly I'm not surprised. **Regardless of what Republicans like Pence throw our way, we will stand strong for our district and what our communities need.**

First and foremost, our campaign has always been about protecting what we love. From our communities and our families, to our democracy, to this beautiful land we call home -- I'm so proud that our community has come together around this theme because it is the source of everything I fight for in Congress.

**But friend, Mike Pence and the GOP are looking to take advantage of the new district maps in states like New Mexico, and NM-03 is on their target list. With our race getting tighter after redistricting, they think we are vulnerable, but I know _nuestra gente_ will step up and help me keep doing the work I love.** [**So please - split a $20 donation between my campaign and Voter Protection Project to help us reach our fundraising goals, push back against Pence and the GOP, and continue fighting for the things we love.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/10042?t=7&akid=1896%2E878179%2EjjT12b) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $20 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/10043?t=8&akid=1896%2E878179%2EjjT12b)

subject: Our veterans need our support
body:
Together we can fight for them

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/5b282c02656d/lori-chavez-deremer-announces-candidacy-for-congress-7061597?e=c87c5d8d97)
https://secure.winred.com/lori-chavez-deremer-for-congress-e8cab5fb/eblast-4-21-22?utm_source=housefile&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eblast421

Friend,

As mayor of Happy Valley, I wanted to do something to support our local veterans.

So, I built a veterans memorial to give our vets a home and our community a place to remember and honor those who served.

https://secure.winred.com/lori-chavez-deremer-for-congress-e8cab5fb/eblast-4-21-22?utm_source=housefile&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eblast421

I realized that in smaller communities, vets don’t always get the recognition they deserve. I want to change that.

In Congress, you can count on me to ALWAYS support our vets. Join me in doing so by chipping in $10, $25, or even $50 today!>>> (https://secure.winred.com/lori-chavez-deremer-for-congress-e8cab5fb/eblast-4-21-22?utm_source=housefile&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eblast421)

https://secure.winred.com/lori-chavez-deremer-for-congress-e8cab5fb/eblast-4-21-22?utm_source=housefile&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eblast421?amount=100
https://secure.winred.com/lori-chavez-deremer-for-congress-e8cab5fb/eblast-4-21-22?utm_source=housefile&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eblast421?amount=50
https://secure.winred.com/lori-chavez-deremer-for-congress-e8cab5fb/eblast-4-21-22?utm_source=housefile&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eblast421?amount=25
https://secure.winred.com/lori-chavez-deremer-for-congress-e8cab5fb/eblast-4-21-22?utm_source=housefile&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eblast421?amount=10

Our vets have given their all in protecting our country, together, we can give our all in supporting them.

Can I count on you to chip in today so we can give ALL veterans across Oregon the recognition they have earned and deserve?>>> (https://secure.winred.com/lori-chavez-deremer-for-congress-e8cab5fb/eblast-4-21-22?utm_source=housefile&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eblast421)

Lori Chavez-DeRemer
Republican Candidate for U.S. Congress

name: Dan Farough
subject: This is what we’re facing
disclaimer_text:
Paid for by
Jocelyn Benson for Secretary of State
body:
Friend,

With Jocelyn’s endorsement convention in the rear view mirror, we’re looking ahead at the next big milestone in this race - the opposition. This coming weekend, the Michigan GOP is going to endorse their candidate for Secretary of State and we’ll be watching closely. (Don’t worry, we’ll keep you updated.)

You and I know that Jocelyn is the best person for the job, no matter who the GOP nominee is. Her re-election represents a crossroads for our state - one that is currently sitting in the national spotlight because of the many ways extremists are trying to limit voting access and undermine our democratic values and institutions. Some lawmakers are even trying to reverse the great strides Jocelyn has made.

This is all to say, we know the next few months are going to be a challenge. Anti-democratic forces are working against us and all of the Democrats running this fall. We have to be prepared for their tricks and be consistently reaching voters and supporters across our state.

It’s no surprise that Trump came to Michigan earlier this month to test his Big Lie propaganda machine by campaigning for the candidates he’s endorsed, including his secretary of state candidate. Not only that, by showing up in person he’s helping their campaigns raise money, intertwining conspiracy with lies.

Where the GOP and Trump sew chaos everywhere they go - including Michigan - Jocelyn’s steady and dependable leadership attracts supporters like you because she is clear eyed and level-headed. Her pro-democracy leadership and commitment to voting access shouldn’t be the things that make her stand out - they should be the standard for any candidate from any party. But that’s simply not our reality anymore.

Right now the GOP front-runner is Trump-endorsed Kristina Karamo. You’ll hear a lot more about her from our team, and likely in the national news, over the next few months. To give you a taste of her anti-democratic positions, she falsely claims Trump won Michigan’s 2020 election and maintains that Antifa posed as Trump supporters and stormed the U.S. Capitol on January 6.

That’s who we’re dealing with, friend. And despite the absurdity of it all, we’re taking this election as seriously as we would against any candidate. The GOP nominee will be well-funded and we don’t doubt that she has supporters who will turn out and vote for her. If there is one thing we’ve learned it’s that a loud-talking lunatic can still find their way into public office.

Thanks for being with us. Your support is essential to making sure we have the resources we need to avoid the chaos and share Jocelyn’s leadership with every Michigander from Copper Harbor to Monroe.

Like I said before, we’ll keep you updated on the GOP’s nomination for this vital role in our state. I tell my team - this is one of those moments where we shouldn’t look away, no matter how chaotic and strange it might seem - because this is when they will start showing their cards for how they’ll run their campaign and what we’re really up against.

If you can, please consider becoming a recurring supporter through the end of this campaign. Even a small monthly amount can add up to a lot if we all chip in.

Donate >> https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=042122D

More soon,

Dan

Campaign Chair

| | Fellow Patriot:

Our families—our _children_ —are under the greatest sustained assault in our history.

Public schools are now nothing more than psychological torture camps.

Education has been replaced by the promotion of the depraved LGBT agenda, a Satanic attack on God and Nature. I call it LGBTP—the P is for pedophilia.

**These sodomite predators are grooming, brainwashing, and _mutilating_ our vulnerable children. These demons are _defiling _innocence itself, and they _must_ be stopped. **

Public school teachers have been caught giving _puberty blockers_ \--**life-altering drugs** \--to children _without parental consent._

I’ll give you just one recent example of what they’re doing to our children all over what used to be America: In California, a mother noticed that her teenage daughter was showing symptoms of depression. She asked her daughter’s school to keep an eye on her. They did.

The school brainwashed the girl into believing she was transgendered, and, when her mother insisted that she see a mental health professional, the school reported this poor mother to social services, who then declared her an unfit mother and took her daughter away. The State of California had already promised the girl it would pay for her “transition.”

This mother was restricted to visiting her daughter once a month, under State supervision.

_During these visits, she was prohibited from making any references to God._ Her daughter eventually committed suicide by throwing herself in front of a train.

And if you _dare_ to stand up for your own children, if you _dare_ to protect them, the Biden DOJ has labeled you a “ _domestic terrorist_.”

One father in Loudoun County, Virginia, was beaten bloody and dragged out of a school board meeting so he wouldn't be able to tell them about his daughter being raped in a school bathroom by a transgender freak.

[It's time for leaders in D.C. who aren't afraid to stand up and fight for our children, and for the sacred rights of parents.](https://NeilforArkansas.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b07b27c744909d0ecfce3d46&id=d9395c4001&e=eda539b26b)

_We need PATRIOTS who will**FIGHT** for the **AMERICAN** people, not limp-waisted frauds who never miss an opportunity to stab us in the back._

[_**Your contributions to my campaign will help me purchase TV and radio ads, yard signs, and other campaign materials so I can fight the worthless GOP, retire a weak RINO, and replace him with a fierce America First Warrior**_.](https://NeilforArkansas.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b07b27c744909d0ecfce3d46&id=5567364470&e=eda539b26b)

Thank you in advance for your generous support. For America,
Neil Robinson Kumar

I wanted to do something different today. I wanted to get personal, explain who I am, and my decision to run for Congress.

**[I hope you’ll read it all the way through and, if you can, chip in a few of your hard-earned dollars to help me raise the kind of money I need to defeat a Capitol Insurrectionist >>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44399174/341415064/-774467154?refcode=ABD_EM_FR_2022.04.21_b1_decision_X_F1_S1_C1__ac&amount=5&utm_campaign=abd_em_fr_2022.04.21_b1_decision_x_f1_s1_c1__ac&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ngp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzIyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYWM2NjhkNS1iMWMxLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sUNAK_CPA7eUYXNqKrS1qOOqrfYWJrHIMkWV489OUno=)**

Let me start by saying something that some people might consider to be pretty radical.

**Rural America is just as important as anywhere else.** I grew up on the farm and it taught me the values I carry with me to this day.

Life on the farm isn’t fancy. But you sure learn a thing or two. You learn humility. Slipping and falling in manure has a way of keeping you grounded.

And when problems come, as they always do, you don’t complain, you get to work. Because talking doesn’t help the crops to grow, get the produce to market or fix that hole in your fence before the cows get out.

That’s why I am so proud of my time working with Governor Evers leading the Wisconsin Department of Agriculture, Trade and Consumer Protection. I fought to get relief for family farmers struggling to make ends meet every single day. When politicians in Madison told me to pipe down, I stood up. When they told me to be quiet, I spoke up louder. **And when they refused to confirm me in the hopes that I might just leave them alone, I got back in the fight.**

I ran for the State Senate. And I won. Now I’m there every day holding them accountable to the people of Wisconsin.

**But my opponent, Derrick Van Orden? He doesn’t understand any of this in the slightest.**

He’s basically got one approach: pit neighbor against neighbor and hope that in all the anger that generates, voters won’t notice that he doesn’t share our values at all. He was on the Capitol grounds on January 6th. That shameful, deadly day. He’s tried to cover it up because he knows people out here think that was wrong. He attacks people. Like teenage librarians. He’s a bully who can only win if we’re as divided as we’ve ever been. And if that doesn’t sound like it will be much help to you, you’re right. Derrick Van Orden is only in this for himself and to do what he’s told by his Washington backers.

But winning this campaign won’t be easy.

**[To defeat Van Orden, we need to build the most sophisticated campaign Wisconsin has ever seen. We need to register new voters, have authentic one-on-one conversations with voters to tell my story, run sophisticated digital advertisements, radio ads, television ads, and more to persuade everyone to join our campaign. But this effort will be expensive. I’m funding this campaign the right way: from small donations given by people reading emails like this one. So even though I hate to ask for money -- I have a humble request:](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44399175/341415065/-774467154?refcode=ABD_EM_FR_2022.04.21_b1_decision_X_F1_S1_C1__ac&amount=5&utm_campaign=abd_em_fr_2022.04.21_b1_decision_x_f1_s1_c1__ac&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ngp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzIyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYWM2NjhkNS1iMWMxLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sUNAK_CPA7eUYXNqKrS1qOOqrfYWJrHIMkWV489OUno=)**

If you believe in me, if you believe we need to keep fighting, even when it’s hard, if you haven’t given up on the rural places many have forgotten -- join me on this journey. | | Dear Peter, Crime is up. Property theft, burglary, assault, homicide...all are more common than they were before Biden took office. North Carolinians are not immune to this trend. According to [a recent assessment](https://courtneygeelsforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0ca724a68d4210b231de53e89&id=9e81a49eda&e=20ac8f046f) comparing per capita homicide rate increases from Q1 2021 to Q1 2022, Durham, NC came in at number 11 and Raleigh came in at 21. Yes, our community boasts two of the top 50 homicide rate increases in the U.S.

The people of North Carolina care about their families. We protect our own. So leave it to Biden and the Democrats to assault the Right to Bear Arms when crime is the worst it's been in years. Biden recently announced [new regulations](https://courtneygeelsforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0ca724a68d4210b231de53e89&id=397050419d&e=20ac8f046f) on so-called "ghost guns", privately made firearms, to supposedly reduce crime. Any idea what % of homicides are traced to privately made firearms on average? 0.7%!!! The rest are either legally obtained weapons, or weapons with serial numbers removed. Banning ghost guns does virtually nothing to reduce violent crime.

In other words, Biden's "ghost gun" regulation is a Trojan Horse for radical gun control. Biden and the Democrats are trying to dismantle the 2nd Amendment.

Crime is a 2nd Amendment issue because the 2nd Amendment gives every American the right to make it more costly for criminals to commit crimes. The 2nd Amendment is about deterrence, not just self-defense. Putin invaded Ukraine because he thought Biden wasn't a risk. Criminals commit crimes because Democrats have condoned it while sabotaging Americans' right to defend themselves.

I am a staunch supporter of the 2nd Amendment, and if elected, I will constantly defend your right to defend yourself and your family. Gisele ❤️

Did you know that Virginia has one of the fastest-growing Arab American communities in the United States? Our district is no exception. With over 16,000 Arabic speakers, we see a vibrant and diverse community integral to our district’s values, culture, and opportunities. From business owners to community leaders, educators, and more, Arab Americans are paving the way for progressive policy in our community.
Arab Americans all over the country continue to be met with needless hostility based on discrimination, hateful rhetoric, and violence. This will not stand. name: Steven Olikara
subject: Our Agenda to Make Government Work for Wisconsin's Exhausted Majority
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Olikara for Senate
body:
Image of Olikara campaign logo with photo of Steven Olikara and link to campaign website:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/90801/images/OfS%20logo%20w%20headshot.png]
[https://www.stevenolikara.com]

Image of U.S. Capitol Rotunda Dome with caption that reads, "Our Agenda to Change the Business Model of Politics: Make Government Work for Wisconsin's Exhausted Majority" and link to policy paper:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/90801/images/Make_Gov_Work_4_Exhausted_Majority.jpeg]
[http://StevenOlikara.com/vision#exhaustedmajority]

Dear Peter,

I’m excited to announce that today we released our agenda to make government work for Wisconsin’s Exhausted Majority. You can read it here [http://StevenOlikara.com/vision#exhaustedmajority] and you can provide the resources we need to deliver our message statewide by donating here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/steven_olikara_for_us_senate?refcode=0421email] .

Image of U.S. Capitol Rotunda Dome with caption that reads, "End legalized bribery in Congress" and link to policy paper:[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/90801/images/End_Legalized_Bribery.jpeg]
[http://StevenOlikara.com/vision#exhaustedmajority]

At over 100 events across Wisconsin with Democrats, Independents, and Republicans, voters agree – we’re tired of a political system in which our voices aren’t heard and politicians profit while pandering to the special interest groups funding their campaigns.

Image of U.S. Capitol Rotunda Dome with caption that reads, "Ban members from fundraising while Congress is in session" and link to policy paper:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/90801/images/Ban_Fundraising_While_in_Session.jpeg]
[http://StevenOlikara.com/vision#exhaustedmajority]

Over 80% of Wisconsinites believe the federal government is fundamentally broken. I launched this campaign with a commitment that my first piece of legislation will be a bipartisan initiative to change the business model of politics by incentivizing Members of Congress to spend less time fundraising and more time legislating. We can enable more working class people, women, and a new set of diverse voices to run for public office.

Image of U.S. Capitol Rotunda Dome with caption that reads, "Enact term limits on members of Congress" and link to policy paper:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/90801/images/Enact_Term_Limits.jpeg]
[http://StevenOlikara.com/vision#exhaustedmajority]

I’m proud to be the first and only candidate in this Senate race to call for term limits in Congress. Term limits motivate Members of Congress to be the change agents we need them to be and to build the bipartisan coalitions necessary to pass meaningful legislation.

Our vision for changing the business model of politics is resonating with voters, we just need the additional resources to deliver our message to more Wisconsinites and build a new kind of politics that elevates dignity over hate.

Button with text that says, "Please Donate Today!" [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/steven_olikara_for_us_senate?refcode=0421email]

Thanks, as always, for your support,
Steven

We need your help to gather the signatures necessary to get on the ballot for the August 9th primary. Please reply "YES" to this email if you can ask friends and family to sign our nomination papers or click the button below to send us an email.
